mystara.power.dragon-tooth.cost_or_limit: Fangs can attack up to 20 inches away; effect ends after five successful attacks; damage depends on dragon type and the user's level.
mystara.power.dragon-tooth.combines: Damage scales to the chosen dragon type when the user's level is sufficient.
mystara.power.dragon-tooth.blocked_reason: The attack can be represented as a bounded force effect.

mystara.power.dragon-eye.name: Dragon Eye

effect.summary: Recognizes a dragon in polymorphed or concealed form.

mystara.power.dragon-eye.cost_or_limit: Fails against dragons with more Hit Dice than the dracologist has levels; lasts one round per level.
mystara.power.dragon-eye.combines: Penetrates illusions and other concealment used by dragons.
mystara.power.dragon-eye.blocked_reason: The ability senses a creature's identity.

mystara.power.dragon-paw.name: Dragon Paw

effect.summary: Grows dragon claws on one or both hands for melee attacks.

mystara.power.dragon-paw.cost_or_limit: Lasts one round per level; claw damage depends on dragon type and may be reduced until the user reaches sufficient level.
mystara.power.dragon-paw.combines: Claw properties follow the selected dragon color.
mystara.power.dragon-paw.blocked_reason: The ability physically alters the user's hands.

mystara.power.dragon-scale.name: Dragon Scale

effect.summary: Covers the user's skin in scales that improve armor protection.

mystara.power.dragon-scale.cost_or_limit: Lasts one round per level; protection depends on dragon type and may remain weaker until the user is sufficiently experienced.
mystara.power.dragon-scale.combines: Armor quality follows the chosen dragon color.
mystara.power.dragon-scale.blocked_reason: A temporary defensive effect fits the basic effect grammar.

mystara.power.dragon-wing.name: Dragon Wing

effect.summary: Grows wings that allow the dracologist to fly.

mystara.power.dragon-wing.cost_or_limit: Lasts one round per level; carrying capacity depends on dragon Hit Dice, with lower speed and load for an under-level user.
mystara.power.dragon-wing.combines: Flight speed and load follow the chosen dragon type.
mystara.power.dragon-wing.blocked_reason: The ability creates functional body parts and alters locomotion.

mystara.power.dragon-breath.name: Dragon Breath

effect.summary: Uses the breath weapon of the chosen dragon type.

mystara.power.dragon-breath.cost_or_limit: Usable three times per day; at insufficient level it causes damage based on half the user's hit points.
mystara.power.dragon-breath.combines: Range and damage follow the chosen dragon type when the user qualifies.
mystara.power.dragon-breath.blocked_reason: A cone-shaped attack with limited daily uses fits the basic effect grammar.

mystara.power.dragon-might.name: Dragon Might

effect.summary: Charms and directs dragons up to a total Hit Dice limit.

mystara.power.dragon-might.cost_or_limit: Maximum total Hit Dice equals the user's level; lasts one turn per level; a broken concentration leaves existing commands in effect.
mystara.power.dragon-might.mind: Controls the dragons' minds and actions.
mystara.power.dragon-might.combines: Controlled dragons can be ridden without risk of falling.
mystara.power.dragon-might.blocked_reason: The ability charms creatures and gives ongoing control through concentration.

mystara.power.high-mastery-of-dragons.name: High Mastery of Dragons

effect.summary: Turns the High Master into the selected dragon type.

mystara.power.high-mastery-of-dragons.cost_or_limit: Transformation takes 1d4 rounds; at level 24 the user can attempt the form of the Dragon Ruler of their alignment, which provokes a duel.
mystara.power.high-mastery-of-dragons.go_wrong: Losing the ruler duel removes that transformation permanently and may make dragons hostile; cheating summons the Great One to punish the user.

mystara.power.high-mastery-of-dragons.blocked_reason: The ability grants a complete creature form and its statistics and powers.

mystara.power.protection-from-elements.name: Protection from Elements

effect.summary: Halves damage from the chosen academy's natural element and enables brief passage over its associated hazard.

mystara.power.protection-from-elements.cost_or_limit: Protection and traversal limits vary by element; traversal lasts up to 90 feet or three rounds.
mystara.power.protection-from-elements.combines: Effects depend on whether the academy is air, water, fire, or earth.
mystara.power.protection-from-elements.blocked_reason: The effect is a limited defensive ability.

mystara.power.major-conjuration.name: Major Conjuration

effect.summary: Summons and controls a creature native to the chosen elemental plane.

mystara.power.major-conjuration.cost_or_limit: Uses the control rules of minor conjuration; a natural 01 makes the summoned creature hostile.
mystara.power.major-conjuration.go_wrong: A natural 01 causes the creatures to become hostile.
mystara.power.major-conjuration.where_from: The elemental plane matching the user's academy.
mystara.power.major-conjuration.combines: Examples include djinni, efreeti, kryst, and undine.
mystara.power.major-conjuration.blocked_reason: The ability summons creatures and grants ongoing control.

mystara.power.metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis

effect.summary: Turns the High Master into an elemental of the chosen academy and permits travel to or from its plane.

mystara.power.metamorphosis.cost_or_limit: Elemental Hit Dice equal the user's level; a natural 01 draws an elemental ruler into pursuit.
mystara.power.metamorphosis.go_wrong: The ruler pursues the High Master in its plane; defeat means death, while victory grants a stronger ruler form restricted to that plane.
mystara.power.metamorphosis.combines: Retains spell and magical-item use and gains the elemental form's abilities.
mystara.power.metamorphosis.blocked_reason: The ability grants a complete elemental form and access to another plane.

mystara.power.nightmares.name: Nightmares

effect.summary: Creates dream combat with nightmare monsters that can cause lasting Constitution loss.

mystara.power.nightmares.cost_or_limit: A victim who wins wakes; lost Constitution returns after a full uninterrupted night's sleep, but reaching zero causes insanity requiring a Heal spell.
mystara.power.nightmares.go_wrong: A natural 01 sends the illusionist to the Dimension of Nightmares.
mystara.power.nightmares.mind: Can cause insanity at zero Constitution.
mystara.power.nightmares.combines: Uses nightmare creatures with statistics set by the DM.
mystara.power.nightmares.blocked_reason: It creates a dream experience that inflicts mental and lasting bodily-state changes.

mystara.power.immobile-objects.name: Immobile objects

effect.summary: Creates still illusory obstacles such as walls, doors, or stairs.

mystara.power.immobile-objects.cost_or_limit: Affects an area covering one yard per level; most such effects are only dispelled if created by a Darkness spell.
mystara.power.immobile-objects.go_wrong: A natural 01 sends the illusionist to the Dimension of Nightmares.
mystara.power.immobile-objects.combines: Most are not normally dispelled; Darkness-created obstacles can be dispelled.
mystara.power.immobile-objects.blocked_reason: The passage does not specify how the illusion interacts with perception or physical passage.

mystara.power.dream-alteration.name: Dream Alteration

effect.summary: Enters and changes a sleeping victim's dreams, potentially sending frightening messages.

mystara.power.dream-alteration.cost_or_limit: Can affect a sleeper at a distance up to one mile per level; repeated failures may permanently bar the illusionist from affecting that victim.
mystara.power.dream-alteration.go_wrong: A natural 01 makes the illusionist fight a nightmare; defeat permanently costs a Constitution point.

mystara.power.dream-alteration.combines: Can produce nightmares and interfere with the victim's rest.
mystara.power.dream-alteration.blocked_reason: It directly alters dreams and can impair the target's mental and restorative state.

mystara.power.protection-from-undead.name: Protection from Undead

effect.summary: Keeps a limited number of undead Hit Dice at bay.

mystara.power.protection-from-undead.cost_or_limit: The limit depends on the necromancer's level; an affected creature's controlled undead do not count toward it.
mystara.power.protection-from-undead.go_wrong: A roll of 01 makes the necromancer unable to harm or affect undead, unless one attacks him or a party member.

mystara.power.protection-from-undead.combines: Attacking the affected undead ends the protection.
mystara.power.protection-from-undead.blocked_reason: It repels a quantified group of undead across an area.

mystara.power.control-undead.name: Control Undead

effect.summary: Controls selected undead up to a Hit Dice limit and lets them follow orders.

mystara.power.control-undead.who_may: A necromancer of the Second Circle.

mystara.power.control-undead.blocked_reason: It imposes continuing control over other beings and can dismiss an undead creature's soul.

mystara.power.create-undead.name: Create Undead

effect.summary: Creates researched types of undead through a ceremony using remains.

mystara.power.create-undead.go_wrong: A roll of 01 causes life-force drainage and damage; the attempt fails and may kill the necromancer, who then becomes undead under the described conditions.
mystara.power.create-undead.who_may: A necromancer of the Third Circle; liches cannot be created this way.
mystara.power.create-undead.combines: Created undead are permanent except skeletons and zombies; they do not require Control Undead.

mystara.power.runes-of-matter.name: Runes of Matter

mystara.power.runes-of-power.name: Runes of Power

mystara.power.runes-of-power.who_may: A runemaster who researches the relevant energy rune.
mystara.power.runes-of-power.combines: Runes may concern fire, cold, electricity, wind, light, or gravity.

mystara.power.runes-of-magic.name: Runes of Magic

effect.summary: Inscribes a spell effect on an item or circle to activate under a specified condition.

mystara.power.runes-of-magic.cost_or_limit: One rune per item; it is permanent until triggered or removed. Five runes make a circle permanent; five magic runes can animate a golem, costing 3,000 gp per asterisk in components.
mystara.power.runes-of-magic.go_wrong: A roll of 01 permanently destroys the golem components.
mystara.power.runes-of-magic.who_may: A runemaster who knows the spell and researches its rune.
mystara.power.runes-of-magic.combines: Dispel magic can remove an item rune; circles can protect, restrain, or trigger spell effects.
mystara.power.runes-of-magic.blocked_reason: It binds a lasting spell effect to an item or circle with activation conditions.

mystara.power.truename.name: Truename

effect.summary: Finds the runic name of one intelligent being and has the effect of a Rune of Life.

mystara.power.brews-and-philters.name: Brews and Philters

mystara.power.dolls-of-sickness.name: Dolls of Sickness

mystara.power.meteor-swarms.combines: Used as the flying machine’s attack.

mystara.institution.serpent-s-byes.who_may: Recruits selected for the covert branch
mystara.institution.serpent-s-byes.combines: Works beneath the broader Second Shadow organization.

mystara.institution.clan-brendyl.name: Clan Brendyl

effect.summary: An elven clan infiltrated by shadow elf agents.

mystara.institution.clan-brendyl.combines: Shadow elf infiltrators operate within it.

mystara.institution.serpent-s-eyes.name: Serpent’s Eyes

effect.summary: A secretive force that can be called upon when needed.

mystara.institution.serpent-s-eyes.combines: Works alongside the Second Shadow’s overt branch.

mystara.institution.the-atruaghin-clans.name: The Atruaghin Clans

effect.summary: none stated

mystara.institution.the-atruaghin-clans.where_from: They live in the western Known World.

effect.summary: A group of tribes whose members follow Atruaghin.

mystara.institution.the-clans.name: The Clans

effect.summary: none stated

mystara.institution.the-clans.where_from: They live on and around the Atruaghin Plateau.

mystara.institution.children-of-the-hors.name: Children of the Horse

effect.summary: They are a warlike clan that communicates through gestures rather than a spoken language.

mystara.institution.children-of-the-hors.cost_or_limit: They reject ranged attacks as dishonorable in warfare.
mystara.institution.children-of-the-hors.where_from: Northern central valleys of the Atruaghin Plateau.

mystara.institution.children-of-the-bear.name: Children of the Bear

effect.summary: They live in cliffside settlements and trade with outsiders.

mystara.institution.children-of-the-bear.where_from: Northeastern rim of the Atruaghin Plateau.

mystara.institution.children-of-the-turt.name: Children of the Turtle

effect.summary: They are seafarers known for whaling and large dugout canoes.

mystara.institution.children-of-the-turt.where_from: At the base of the plateau on the Sea of Dread coast.

mystara.institution.children-of-the-tige.name: Children of the Tiger

effect.summary: They wage war on the other clans and serve Entropy under Atzanteotl’s influence.

mystara.institution.children-of-the-tige.cost_or_limit: Their society is controlled by a hostile theocracy.
mystara.institution.children-of-the-tige.go_wrong: They are described as corrupted and used as pawns by evil forces.
mystara.institution.children-of-the-tige.where_from: Forests by the Malpheggi Swamp coast.
mystara.institution.children-of-the-tige.combines: They follow Atzanteotl and the forces of Entropy.

mystara.institution.children-of-the-elk.name: Children of the Elk

effect.summary: They inhabit pine forests and sometimes fight the Tiger Clan.

mystara.institution.children-of-the-elk.combines: They have a particular hostility toward the Tiger Clan.

effect.summary: Buffalo-hunting clan culture.
Whaling clan culture.
A clan culture described as evil.
One of five distinct clan cultures.

mystara.institution.military-orders-of-t.name: Military Orders of the Eternal Way

effect.summary: Military orders of True Believer warriors trained for service.

mystara.institution.military-orders-of-t.cost_or_limit: Applicants must supply their own horse and arms.
mystara.institution.military-orders-of-t.mind: Members submit fully to trainers through religious oath.

effect.summary: Heavy infantry order drawn from urban strong recruits, assigned to palace guard or elite units.
Mounted archer order, often of Makistani descent, serving the Sultan's Peacekeeping Guard or scouts.

mystara.institution.order-of-the-spell.name: Order of the Spell

effect.summary: Mounted skirmishing magic users who cast spells under fire while riding.

mystara.institution.order-of-the-spell.cost_or_limit: Must be excellent horsemen; need not supply standard armor.
mystara.institution.order-of-the-spell.who_may: Magic users with tough constitution and skill.

mystara.institution.order-of-the-mace.name: Order of the Mace

effect.summary: Order of clerics who lead, support and heal as officers in palace or army units.

mystara.institution.order-of-the-mace.who_may: Prayer leaders and itinerants of high constitution and wisdom.

effect.summary: One of the five Military Orders, named as the honorary order's governing council's namesake.Named only in list of orders.

mystara.institution.order-of-the-lance.name: Order of the Lance

effect.summary: Honorary order of the finest soldiers, magic users and clerics, called Knights of the Rose, often made captains or faris.

mystara.institution.order-of-the-lance.cost_or_limit: Selected by the Council of the Desert Rose.
mystara.institution.order-of-the-lance.mind: Dedicated to the principles of Al-Kalim and the Nahmeh.
mystara.institution.order-of-the-lance.who_may: Members chosen from other orders by the Council.

effect.summary: none
none

mystara.institution.free-and-anachronic-.name: Free and Anachronic Society of Aalban

effect.summary: Semi-legal scientific society opposed to machinery and technical invention.
Secret order of alchemists at the Great School of Magic, divided into five circles under a High Master.
Secret order of elementalists with four rival academies of earth, air, fire and water.

mystara.institution.brotherhood.name: Brotherhood

effect.summary: Brotherhood of Rad whose members draw power from the Radiance and seek Immortal status.

mystara.institution.brotherhood.who_may: loyal Glantrian nobles who find the Radiance

effect.summary: none
none
Freebooters who carry smuggled trade between the Shires and outside merchants.
none
none
none

mystara.institution.minro-navy.name: Minro-Navy

effect.summary: Navy that follows a ship rank hierarchy similar to the guilds.

mystara.institution.minro-navy.who_may: Officers who rose through the ranks

effect.summary: Temple official who collects miners' ore for payment and storage.
Group plotting to seize the mines and overthrow the High Priest.
Orcish gang hired out for evil deeds, known for sudden mood changes.
School training the most powerful priests of Atzanteotl in official history and casting.
Orc family of detectives and lawyers who take a fee of 10% of client belongings.

mystara.rule.noble-land-forfeiture.name: Noble land forfeiture

effect.summary: The Duke may confiscate a convicted peer’s lands, but should pass them to heirs to avoid alarming other nobles.

mystara.rule.noble-land-forfeiture.cost_or_limit: The confiscation applies to a peer convicted of a crime.
mystara.rule.noble-land-forfeiture.go_wrong: Removing a noble’s land without recognizing heirs could unsettle the nobility.
mystara.rule.noble-land-forfeiture.blocked_reason: This is a political and legal rule, not an effect outside the basic grammar.

mystara.rule.purification-for-sin.name: Purification for sin

effect.summary: Church authorities may require purification ceremonies, with severity reflecting the wrongdoing.

mystara.rule.purification-for-sin.cost_or_limit: Serious offenses may bring both secular punishment and exclusion from the church.
mystara.rule.purification-for-sin.who_may: Church authorities determine the required purification.
mystara.rule.purification-for-sin.blocked_reason: This rule concerns institutional punishment and does not require a missing effect capability.

mystara.rule.karameikan-taxes.name: Karameikan taxes

effect.summary: Workers and business owners report earnings; farmers generally pay taxes in crops or livestock, and nobles forward a fifth of their receipts to the Duke.

mystara.rule.karameikan-taxes.cost_or_limit: Tax rates and obligations vary by status and landholder.
mystara.rule.karameikan-taxes.go_wrong: Tax avoidance can lead to investigation, charges, arrest, trial, and conviction.
mystara.rule.karameikan-taxes.who_may: People earning income in Karameikos, with stated exceptions.
mystara.rule.karameikan-taxes.combines: Tax revenue supports the Duke and local protection or services.
mystara.rule.karameikan-taxes.blocked_reason: This economic rule can be represented as a recurring financial obligation.

mystara.rule.church-tithes.name: Church tithes

effect.summary: People are not legally required to tithe, though churches receive voluntary contributions.

mystara.rule.church-tithes.combines: Churches use income for buildings, clergy, services, and political influence.
mystara.rule.church-tithes.blocked_reason: This is a social and economic rule, not a special supernatural effect.

mystara.rule.nithian-memory-concealment.name: Nithian memory concealment

effect.summary: People entering the artifact's 24-mile-hex range forget what they know about Nithia.

mystara.rule.nithian-memory-concealment.cost_or_limit: The effect covers a 24-mile hex around the artifact.
mystara.rule.nithian-memory-concealment.mind: Erases Nithian knowledge from affected minds.
mystara.rule.nithian-memory-concealment.who_may: Applies to people passing within range
mystara.rule.nithian-memory-concealment.combines: Immortal servants may also cause forgetting
mystara.rule.nithian-memory-concealment.blocked_reason: Selective area-wide memory erasure is beyond the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.nithian-obscurity-curse.name: Nithian obscurity curse

effect.summary: The Immortals' curse keeps the Nithian people and their history obscure.

mystara.rule.nithian-obscurity-curse.cost_or_limit: Applies to knowledge of Nithia; no exact scope is given.
mystara.rule.nithian-obscurity-curse.combines: Artifact and servants help maintain the obscurity
mystara.rule.nithian-obscurity-curse.blocked_reason: The passage describes broad historical concealment without a defined game effect.

mystara.rule.dinar-exchange-value.name: Dinar exchange value

effect.summary: One dinar equals ten dirhams.

mystara.rule.dinar-exchange-value.combines: Combines with the dirham-to-fals exchange rule.

mystara.rule.dirham-exchange-value.name: Dirham exchange value

effect.summary: One dirham equals ten fals.

mystara.rule.dirham-exchange-value.combines: Combines with the dinar-to-dirham exchange rule.

mystara.rule.emirates-coinage-metals.name: Emirates coinage metals

effect.summary: The Emirates does not mint platinum or electrum coins because those metals are not produced there in quantity.

mystara.rule.emirates-coinage-metals.cost_or_limit: Limited local production of the metals

mystara.rule.dream-of-justice-and-honor.name: Dream of Justice and Honor

effect.summary: True Believers are strongly enjoined not to take up arms against one another.

mystara.rule.dream-of-justice-and-honor.cost_or_limit: The injunction is often evaded by treating an opponent as unrighteous or provoking the first attack.
mystara.rule.dream-of-justice-and-honor.combines: Supports ideals of justice and trust among people.

mystara.rule.water-ritual.name: Water Ritual

effect.summary: Believers meeting one another should symbolically share water, sometimes through elaborate drink-sharing.

mystara.rule.water-ritual.cost_or_limit: Observance ranges from a token gesture to a formal shared drink.
mystara.rule.water-ritual.combines: May be performed with coffee or tea.

mystara.rule.truthtelling.name: Truthtelling

effect.summary: A believer must not lie to another believer; breaking a formal vow brings a curse and social scorn.

mystara.rule.truthtelling.cost_or_limit: Formal vows may be sworn before a holy person.
mystara.rule.truthtelling.go_wrong: Breaking a vow incurs a curse and ostracism.
mystara.rule.truthtelling.combines: May be affirmed with an oath invoking Al-Kalim and the Eternal Truth.

mystara.rule.attendance-to-the-security-.name: Attendance to the Security of Your Fellow Man

effect.summary: Believers should aid the poor and answer calls to defend others, especially fellow kin, tribe members, and treaty allies.

mystara.rule.attendance-to-the-security-.cost_or_limit: The term fellow man is often interpreted narrowly as kin, tribal allies, or treaty partners.
mystara.rule.attendance-to-the-security-.combines: Can include giving alms and answering a chief’s call to war against unbelievers.

mystara.rule.dream-of-the-garden-in-the-.name: Dream of the Garden in the Desert

effect.summary: Society should cooperate in developing and efficiently managing water for all the Emirates’ peoples.

mystara.rule.dream-of-the-garden-in-the-.cost_or_limit: Calls for scholarly study, wealthy support, and peasant cooperation.
mystara.rule.dream-of-the-garden-in-the-.who_may: Chiefs, scholars, holy men, merchants, wealthy people, and peasants each have roles.
mystara.rule.dream-of-the-garden-in-the-.combines: Common acceptance helped make water projects successful.

mystara.rule.prayer-and-meditation-obser.name: Prayer and meditation observance

effect.summary: True Believers must pray and meditate at sunrise and sunset.

mystara.rule.prayer-and-meditation-obser.cost_or_limit: Disrupting observance is socially offensive in cities and may be a capital offense among desert nomads.

mystara.rule.full-moon-fast.name: Full-moon fast

effect.summary: Believers fast for twenty-four hours from sunset to sunset on the day of the full moon, then feast and dedicate some food to the Immortal Guardians or the poor.

mystara.rule.full-moon-fast.cost_or_limit: A twenty-four-hour fast followed by a dedicated portion of food.
mystara.rule.full-moon-fast.combines: The dedicated food may be symbolic or shared with the poor.

mystara.rule.judgment-ritual.name: Judgment ritual

effect.summary: A believer judging an issue should contemplate, weigh evidence, and decide from knowledge rather than tradition or superstition.

mystara.rule.judgment-ritual.cost_or_limit: Judgment is intended to be patient, methodical, and solemn.
mystara.rule.judgment-ritual.go_wrong: Impulsive judgment from anger or arrogance is considered irresponsible.
mystara.rule.judgment-ritual.who_may: A True Believer asked to judge
mystara.rule.judgment-ritual.combines: Applies to scientific, military, and ritual-law questions.

mystara.rule.nahmeh-study-ritual.name: Nahmeh study ritual

effect.summary: Believers are expected to read, recite, and study the Nahmeh.

mystara.rule.nahmeh-study-ritual.go_wrong: Clerics who neglect the Articles of Faith may fail to receive prayers answered.
mystara.rule.nahmeh-study-ritual.combines: The book is widely memorized and treasured.

mystara.rule.pilgrimage.name: Pilgrimage

effect.summary: Pilgrimage is encouraged for people in good health and with sufficient means, but is not mandatory.

mystara.rule.pilgrimage.cost_or_limit: Good health and adequate means are practical requirements.
mystara.rule.pilgrimage.who_may: Those in good health and with sufficient means
mystara.rule.pilgrimage.combines: May involve visiting Ylaruam or another center of learning.

mystara.rule.oath-of-truthtelling.name: Oath of Truthtelling

effect.summary: An insincere oath of faith may be punished by a curse.

mystara.rule.oath-of-truthtelling.cost_or_limit: The curse can be ambiguous and difficult to identify
mystara.rule.oath-of-truthtelling.combines: The faith ritual and the truthtelling spell
mystara.rule.oath-of-truthtelling.blocked_reason: The curse's nature and timing are determined case by case rather than by the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.well-permits-and-licenses.name: Well permits and licenses

effect.summary: A well requires a permit to be dug and a license limiting yearly water withdrawal.

mystara.rule.well-permits-and-licenses.cost_or_limit: Applications need an approved agricultural or vegetative plan; residential supply is conditional
mystara.rule.well-permits-and-licenses.go_wrong: Unregulated extraction can deplete reservoirs and dry wells
mystara.rule.well-permits-and-licenses.who_may: Water Resources and Agriculture administer the system
mystara.rule.well-permits-and-licenses.combines: Water surveys may use detect water

effect.summary: Water may not be sold; excess use can bring fines or imprisonment.

mystara.rule.wilderness-research-permits.name: Wilderness research permits

effect.summary: Expeditions are supposed to obtain permits, particularly if they expect to profit.

mystara.rule.wilderness-research-permits.cost_or_limit: A permit requires proof of qualifications and preparation.
mystara.rule.wilderness-research-permits.go_wrong: Unpermitted profits may cause legal problems on return.
mystara.rule.wilderness-research-permits.combines: Ancient sites require a specific research permit.

mystara.rule.ancient-site-entry-permit.name: Ancient-site entry permit

effect.summary: Entry to ancient ruins and tombs is forbidden without a research permit.

mystara.rule.ancient-site-entry-permit.cost_or_limit: Applicants must demonstrate expertise, safeguards, and equipment.
mystara.rule.ancient-site-entry-permit.go_wrong: Entry may awaken evils, plagues, or curses.
mystara.rule.ancient-site-entry-permit.combines: Enforced by faris, the Order of the Rose, and clerics.

mystara.rule.emirates-legal-judgment.name: Emirates legal judgment

effect.summary: Judges may weigh motives and circumstances rather than applying laws as absolute rules.

mystara.rule.emirates-legal-judgment.cost_or_limit: Judgment should rest on observed evidence and knowledge.
mystara.rule.emirates-legal-judgment.go_wrong: Rich or well-advised defendants may evade prosecution.
mystara.rule.emirates-legal-judgment.who_may: Rulers, magistrates, officials, faris, and other empowered judges
mystara.rule.emirates-legal-judgment.combines: Written law coexists with custom and personal judgment.

mystara.rule.religious-court-punishment-.name: Religious court punishment limit

effect.summary: A religious court may censure, curse, or expel a wrongdoer from the Faith, but formally cannot otherwise punish.

mystara.rule.religious-court-punishment-.cost_or_limit: Rural religious judges may also act as civil judges.
mystara.rule.religious-court-punishment-.go_wrong: Social pressure can cause business or subjects to abandon the condemned person.
mystara.rule.religious-court-punishment-.combines: Religious and civil authority may overlap in rural areas.

mystara.rule.foreigners-and-unbelievers-.name: Foreigners' and unbelievers' taxes

effect.summary: Foreigners and unbelievers pay a monthly poll tax and individual tax, plus a sales duty.

mystara.rule.foreigners-and-unbelievers-.cost_or_limit: Each monthly tax is 10 dinar; sales duty is 10% of market value.
mystara.rule.foreigners-and-unbelievers-.combines: They are exempt from military and certain public services.

mystara.rule.foreign-quarters-jurisdicti.name: Foreign quarters' jurisdiction

effect.summary: Foreign quarters may set and enforce their own laws unless these harm True Believers; disputes with citizens fall under Emirates law.

mystara.rule.foreign-quarters-jurisdicti.cost_or_limit: Local self-rule applies only within designated quarters and subject to that restriction.
mystara.rule.foreign-quarters-jurisdicti.who_may: Foreign quarters and their chosen rulers or councils
mystara.rule.foreign-quarters-jurisdicti.combines: Emirates law governs disputes between a foreigner and a citizen.

mystara.rule.nomadic-land-and-resource-u.name: Nomadic land and resource use

effect.summary: Nomadic passage, water use, and pasturage depend on customary use and power; scarcity favors the strong.

mystara.rule.nomadic-land-and-resource-u.cost_or_limit: No ordinary concept of private land ownership applies among nomads.
mystara.rule.nomadic-land-and-resource-u.go_wrong: Scarcity can make access dependent on force.

mystara.rule.urban-land-tenure.name: Urban land tenure

effect.summary: Most city land belongs to the city and can be leased but not sold.

mystara.rule.urban-land-tenure.cost_or_limit: Leases may be cancelled for legal or contract violations.
mystara.rule.urban-land-tenure.combines: Guilds, merchants, and nobles commonly lease land.

mystara.rule.dominion-succession.name: Dominion succession

effect.summary: Traditional dominions pass by inheritance subject to review; modern dominions require ruler approval for successors.

mystara.rule.dominion-succession.cost_or_limit: A successor can be rejected, returning the land to government control.
mystara.rule.dominion-succession.go_wrong: Incompetence or moral offenses may disqualify an heir.
mystara.rule.dominion-succession.combines: Traditional and post-Al-Kalim dominions follow different inheritance rules.

mystara.rule.sorcerer-identification.name: Sorcerer identification

effect.summary: Sorcerers are required to identify their profession through distinctive marked clothing.

mystara.rule.sorcerer-identification.cost_or_limit: The inscription must prominently identify the wearer as a practicing sorcerer.
mystara.rule.sorcerer-identification.go_wrong: Concealment may lead to exile or imprisonment.
mystara.rule.sorcerer-identification.combines: Sorcery is regulated and taxed as a craft.

mystara.rule.clerical-spell-fees.name: Clerical spell fees

effect.summary: Clerics may not charge private fees for spells; payments must support religious institutions and works.

mystara.rule.clerical-spell-fees.cost_or_limit: All remuneration is restricted to approved religious support.

mystara.rule.slavery-and-debt-indenture.name: Slavery and debt indenture

effect.summary: Slavery is illegal except as compensation for unlawful debt, with indenture limited to one to five years.

mystara.rule.slavery-and-debt-indenture.cost_or_limit: Only debtors may be sold, and only for unpaid debts.
mystara.rule.slavery-and-debt-indenture.go_wrong: Inspectors check that slaves are not mistreated.
mystara.rule.slavery-and-debt-indenture.combines: Indentured people retain civil rights except choice of employer and work.

mystara.rule.foreign-quarter-religious-a.name: Foreign quarter religious and cultural privacy

effect.summary: Foreigners may observe their own religious and cultural practices privately in their homes.

mystara.rule.foreign-quarter-religious-a.cost_or_limit: They remain subject to Emirates law outside their quarter and in disputes with citizens.
mystara.rule.foreign-quarter-religious-a.combines: Foreign quarters provide broader local autonomy.

mystara.rule.water-crime-penalties.name: Water crime penalties

effect.summary: Water theft, unlicensed wells, waste, and related offenses can bring fines, compensation, confiscation, or imprisonment.

mystara.rule.water-crime-penalties.cost_or_limit: Well poisoning may bring confiscation, flogging, and death.
mystara.rule.water-crime-penalties.combines: Sentences depend on the specific water offense.

mystara.rule.the-eternal-truth.name: The Eternal Truth

effect.summary: none stated

mystara.rule.the-eternal-truth.combines: Also called the Faith and the Way.

mystara.rule.al-kalim-forbids-ylari-to-f.name: Al-Kalim forbids Ylari to fight with one another.

effect.summary: Ylari are religiously prohibited from fighting each other, though the rule is often broken.

mystara.rule.al-kalim-forbids-ylari-to-f.cost_or_limit: Contests can be agreed upon to settle disputes while limiting bloodshed.
mystara.rule.al-kalim-forbids-ylari-to-f.combines: Duels and mock wars may serve as alternatives.

mystara.rule.alasiyan-steed-class-and-pr.name: Alasiyan steed class and price

effect.summary: Steed classes set movement and purchase-price ranges.

mystara.rule.alasiyan-steed-class-and-pr.cost_or_limit: Classes range from Nag to Superb, with higher speed generally costing more.
mystara.rule.alasiyan-steed-class-and-pr.blocked_reason: It maps to ordinary mount statistics and requires no extra basic-effect capability.

mystara.rule.guessing-a-horse-s-quality.name: Guessing a horse’s quality

effect.summary: A secret 3d6 comparison determines how accurately a rider judges a horse’s class.

mystara.rule.guessing-a-horse-s-quality.cost_or_limit: The rider’s riding rating is compared with the 3d6 result.
mystara.rule.guessing-a-horse-s-quality.go_wrong: A mistaken estimate may rate the horse one or two classes too high or low.
mystara.rule.guessing-a-horse-s-quality.combines: Odd misjudgments favor the horse; even ones undervalue it.
mystara.rule.guessing-a-horse-s-quality.blocked_reason: This is a game resolution rule, not a supernatural effect.

mystara.rule.detecting-a-serious-horse-d.name: Detecting a serious horse defect

effect.summary: A riding test can reveal a serious defect before purchase.

mystara.rule.detecting-a-serious-horse-d.cost_or_limit: The riding rating sets the percentage chance of detection.
mystara.rule.detecting-a-serious-horse-d.go_wrong: A concealed defect can emerge during play or a critical event.
mystara.rule.detecting-a-serious-horse-d.combines: A d6 determines whether a serious defect exists.

mystara.rule.untreated-well-water-harms-.name: Untreated Well water harms humans

effect.summary: Repeated drinking can cause weakness, paralysis, and death within a week.

mystara.rule.untreated-well-water-harms-.cost_or_limit: Humans are affected; animals are not. Clerics purify water for human use.
mystara.rule.untreated-well-water-harms-.who_may: Humans who frequently drink the water.
mystara.rule.untreated-well-water-harms-.where_from: The Well of the Faithful Prophet.
mystara.rule.untreated-well-water-harms-.blocked_reason: The staged disease progression and delayed death are not expressible with the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.requests-of-local-npcs.name: Requests of Local NPCs

effect.summary: Prior hospitality, aid, or personal ties may obligate characters to fulfill requests.

mystara.rule.requests-of-local-npcs.cost_or_limit: Obligations may arise from religion, politics, honor, sympathy, or family and tribal ties.
mystara.rule.requests-of-local-npcs.who_may: Characters with relevant obligations or prior ties
mystara.rule.requests-of-local-npcs.combines: May involve requests from prayer leaders, Daood, officials, or hosts.
mystara.rule.requests-of-local-npcs.blocked_reason: A lasting relation can represent an obligation.

mystara.rule.feast-at-bayt-saddam.name: Feast at Bayt Saddam

effect.summary: Following the feast’s social rituals can earn respect; breaches can reduce standing or support.

mystara.rule.feast-at-bayt-saddam.cost_or_limit: Discussing business before the ninth step costs 10 XP each time; specified conduct earns or loses XP.
mystara.rule.feast-at-bayt-saddam.go_wrong: Improper conduct can mark guests as boors and jeopardize aid.
mystara.rule.feast-at-bayt-saddam.combines: Greeting, gifts, coffee, conversation, meal, music, storytelling, and then business.
mystara.rule.feast-at-bayt-saddam.blocked_reason: The described consequences can be represented as changes to relations and XP.

mystara.rule.challenge-to-defend-claimed.name: Challenge to defend claimed status

effect.summary: Claiming a title or ability obligates a character to defend that claim against a worthy challenger.

mystara.rule.challenge-to-defend-claimed.cost_or_limit: The challenger must be an equal or better; a fair challenge may be deferred for injury, urgent business, unfairness, or serious danger.
mystara.rule.challenge-to-defend-claimed.go_wrong: Refusing a fair challenge loses status and some XP, up to 1/100 of the gap to the next level.
mystara.rule.challenge-to-defend-claimed.who_may: Anyone claiming status based on title, ability, or achievement
mystara.rule.challenge-to-defend-claimed.combines: Challenges may be contests, tournaments, or mock wars.
mystara.rule.challenge-to-defend-claimed.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as an obligation with a defined penalty.

mystara.rule.al-kalim-s-injunction-again.name: Al-Kalim’s injunction against attacking another of the Faith

effect.summary: The injunction forbids attacks on fellow members of the Faith and channels aggression into contests.

mystara.rule.al-kalim-s-injunction-again.go_wrong: Brigands who violate it rationalize their attacks by declaring victims infidels.
mystara.rule.al-kalim-s-injunction-again.combines: Encourages contests, tournaments, and mock wars instead of attacks.
mystara.rule.al-kalim-s-injunction-again.blocked_reason: The restriction is straightforward to represent as a prohibition.

mystara.rule.breaking-a-truthtelling-oat.name: Breaking a truthtelling oath risks a curse

effect.summary: A person who breaks a truth-telling oath risks incurring a curse.

mystara.rule.breaking-a-truthtelling-oat.cost_or_limit: The curse is a risk, not a certainty
mystara.rule.breaking-a-truthtelling-oat.who_may: Those who swear such an oath
mystara.rule.breaking-a-truthtelling-oat.blocked_reason: The passage states the rule but does not detail the curse’s effect.

mystara.rule.disobedience-to-rightful-au.name: Disobedience to rightful authority is unlawful and punished severely

effect.summary: Ylari are obliged to obey legitimate leaders, with severe practical consequences for disobedience.

mystara.rule.disobedience-to-rightful-au.go_wrong: Disobedience can bring severe punishment and dishonor
mystara.rule.disobedience-to-rightful-au.blocked_reason: This is a social and legal rule.

mystara.rule.magical-curse.name: Magical Curse

effect.summary: Valuable magical items are assumed to carry a curse, triggered by touch or prohibited use.

mystara.rule.magical-curse.cost_or_limit: The curse's trigger and effect are chosen for the item.
mystara.rule.magical-curse.mind: Some curses affect memory, will, or possession.
mystara.rule.magical-curse.combines: Can coexist with physical traps and guardians.
mystara.rule.magical-curse.blocked_reason: The passage permits many distinct curse effects that do not fit one basic effect.

mystara.rule.lizardskin-bed-transformati.name: Lizardskin Bed transformation

effect.summary: Recipients and the owner gradually turn into lizardmen, with memory and identity changes for the owner.

mystara.rule.lizardskin-bed-transformati.cost_or_limit: The change begins after treatment or the owner's first use and develops over three months.
mystara.rule.lizardskin-bed-transformati.go_wrong: The owner loses present memories, adopts the maker's identity, and may enter ability-disabling trances after taking damage.
mystara.rule.lizardskin-bed-transformati.mind: The owner undergoes memory loss and identity replacement.
mystara.rule.lizardskin-bed-transformati.combines: Remove curse can arrest the change; dispel magic can remove it versus a 20th-level caster.
mystara.rule.lizardskin-bed-transformati.blocked_reason: It entails gradual body transformation plus an identity and memory alteration.

mystara.rule.silverton-etiquette-penalti.name: Silverton etiquette penalties

effect.summary: Ignoring etiquette at the castle can lead to lashes or temporary feeblemindedness.

mystara.rule.silverton-etiquette-penalti.cost_or_limit: Punishment ranges from twelve lashes to as much as four weeks of feeblemindedness.
mystara.rule.silverton-etiquette-penalti.mind: The harshest penalty impairs the mind temporarily.
mystara.rule.silverton-etiquette-penalti.who_may: Those who violate etiquette at the castle.
mystara.rule.silverton-etiquette-penalti.blocked_reason: This is a setting law that can be implemented as a consequence of breaking a social rule.

mystara.rule.vampire-s-law.name: Vampire's Law

effect.summary: Morphail's undead pawns cannot infect commoners or kill while feeding.

mystara.rule.vampire-s-law.cost_or_limit: Pawns may not infect commoners or kill their victims when feeding.
mystara.rule.vampire-s-law.go_wrong: Breaking the law can lead to consequences under Morphail's rule.
mystara.rule.vampire-s-law.combines: The restriction is enforced on undead pawns under Morphail's control.
mystara.rule.vampire-s-law.blocked_reason: This is a clear rule limiting whom vampires may infect and whether feeding may kill.

mystara.rule.morphail-s-destruction-free.name: Morphail's destruction frees Boldavian undead

effect.summary: If Morphail is destroyed, the Boldavian undead under his control become independent.

mystara.rule.morphail-s-destruction-free.go_wrong: The undead become independent of him.
mystara.rule.morphail-s-destruction-free.combines: The rule depends on the prince's destruction.
mystara.rule.morphail-s-destruction-free.blocked_reason: The rule depends on a supernatural control bond and its release, which the basic effect grammar does not model.

mystara.rule.radiance-overuse-can-cause-.name: Radiance overuse can cause lichdom

effect.summary: Excessive use of the Radiance can transform a practitioner into a lich.

mystara.rule.radiance-overuse-can-cause-.cost_or_limit: The risk follows from overusing the Radiance.
mystara.rule.radiance-overuse-can-cause-.go_wrong: The practitioner may become a lich.
mystara.rule.radiance-overuse-can-cause-.combines: The passage describes Brannart as having suffered this outcome.
mystara.rule.radiance-overuse-can-cause-.blocked_reason: The rule specifies a transformation to an undead state beyond the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.oracle-s-tree-payment.name: Oracle's tree payment

effect.summary: A client of the clan's oracles must plant ten trees where none grow and care for them until they are twice the client's size.

mystara.rule.oracle-s-tree-payment.cost_or_limit: Plant and tend ten trees until each reaches twice the client's size.
mystara.rule.oracle-s-tree-payment.go_wrong: Failure can bring curses or geas, with consequences left uncertain.
mystara.rule.oracle-s-tree-payment.mind: A geas may be imposed on a noncompliant client.
mystara.rule.oracle-s-tree-payment.who_may: Clients seeking the clan's oracle services.
mystara.rule.oracle-s-tree-payment.combines: The oracles know when a client fails to meet the obligation.
mystara.rule.oracle-s-tree-payment.blocked_reason: This is a service obligation with a clear cost and possible consequence.

mystara.rule.ghostly-return-after-death.name: Ghostly return after death

effect.summary: Myra returned to her tower as a ghost after being killed.

mystara.rule.ghostly-return-after-death.cost_or_limit: The passage describes Myra's specific return but gives no general method or limits.
mystara.rule.ghostly-return-after-death.go_wrong: She remains bound to her affairs and seeks revenge.
mystara.rule.ghostly-return-after-death.mind: She conceals her ghostly nature from others.
mystara.rule.ghostly-return-after-death.where_from: Her death and return to Uigami.
mystara.rule.ghostly-return-after-death.combines: She continues to rule while appearing alive.
mystara.rule.ghostly-return-after-death.blocked_reason: A character's existence after death and return as a ghost cannot be implemented with the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.grain-silo-access.name: Grain silo access

effect.summary: Magically sealed silo openings require a special word to unlock.

mystara.rule.grain-silo-access.cost_or_limit: The Port Authorities know the word.
mystara.rule.grain-silo-access.blocked_reason: A keyed magical restriction is not represented by the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.mage-knowledge-and-noble-st.name: Mage knowledge and noble status

effect.summary: Knowledge of magic is the route to noble rank, privileges, and status in Glantri.

mystara.rule.mage-knowledge-and-noble-st.cost_or_limit: Greater arcane skill brings higher status.
mystara.rule.mage-knowledge-and-noble-st.go_wrong: Abandoning the mage's craft forfeits the servant's loyalty and blocks advancement.
mystara.rule.mage-knowledge-and-noble-st.who_may: People who learn magic may seek higher status.
mystara.rule.mage-knowledge-and-noble-st.combines: Wealth can also buy access to the higher class.
mystara.rule.mage-knowledge-and-noble-st.blocked_reason: This is a social rule that can be represented without an unsupported effect.

mystara.rule.wealth-and-social-advanceme.name: Wealth and social advancement

effect.summary: After subsistence, a mundaner seeks wealth, which can open doors or buy access to the higher class.

mystara.rule.wealth-and-social-advanceme.cost_or_limit: Gold is the means of advancement described.
mystara.rule.wealth-and-social-advanceme.blocked_reason: This is a social rule that can be represented without an unsupported effect.

mystara.rule.licenses.name: Licenses

effect.summary: Activities requiring a license are prohibited without authorization.

mystara.rule.licenses.cost_or_limit: Applicants must explain their need and expected use; fees vary by activity.
mystara.rule.licenses.go_wrong: Unlicensed use can bring punishment, and showing no license when asked is treated as guilt.
mystara.rule.licenses.who_may: People seeking to perform regulated activities must obtain licenses.
mystara.rule.licenses.combines: Several activities and spell effects are licensed separately.
mystara.rule.licenses.blocked_reason: A legal permission restriction can be represented as a gate.

mystara.rule.license-fees-and-spell-use-.name: License fees and spell-use limits

effect.summary: Spellcasting and other activities have distinct licensing requirements and fees, sometimes based on spell level or spell type.

mystara.rule.license-fees-and-spell-use-.cost_or_limit: Examples include charges for hazardous urban magic, private spellcasting, arcane business, and public speaking.
mystara.rule.license-fees-and-spell-use-.go_wrong: Unlicensed activity can lead to suspension or other penalties.
mystara.rule.license-fees-and-spell-use-.who_may: Licensed spellcasters and other regulated practitioners.
mystara.rule.license-fees-and-spell-use-.where_from: House of Ministers and other Glantrian authorities.
mystara.rule.license-fees-and-spell-use-.combines: Spellcasters may need a separate license for each spell used for business.
mystara.rule.license-fees-and-spell-use-.blocked_reason: The rule is a cost and authorization constraint.

mystara.rule.public-speaking-license.name: Public speaking license

effect.summary: Addressing ten or more people who can all hear requires a license.

mystara.rule.public-speaking-license.cost_or_limit: The stated fee is 50 ducats per year.
mystara.rule.public-speaking-license.go_wrong: Speaking without authorization can result in a charge.
mystara.rule.public-speaking-license.who_may: Scholars, magistrates, entertainers, officers, merchants, and other public speakers.
mystara.rule.public-speaking-license.combines: Court appearances also require the public-speaking license if addressing magistrates.
mystara.rule.public-speaking-license.blocked_reason: A crowd-size condition and authorization gate are straightforward constraints.

mystara.rule.hazardous-magic-in-urban-ar.name: Hazardous Magic in Urban Areas

effect.summary: Producing specified hazardous magical effects in urban areas requires a license.

mystara.rule.hazardous-magic-in-urban-ar.cost_or_limit: The fee is 100 ducats per year per spell in Glantri City.
mystara.rule.hazardous-magic-in-urban-ar.go_wrong: Using such magic without authorization is punishable.
mystara.rule.hazardous-magic-in-urban-ar.combines: The restriction lists dangerous spells and effects, including conjured elementals and weather control.
mystara.rule.hazardous-magic-in-urban-ar.blocked_reason: The rule depends on an urban-area condition applied to magical effects.

mystara.rule.felony-limitation-period.name: Felony limitation period

effect.summary: An offender not apprehended within the week after a felony can no longer legally be punished for it.

mystara.rule.felony-limitation-period.cost_or_limit: The period ends at sunrise on the eighth day.
mystara.rule.felony-limitation-period.who_may: Applies to offenders under Glantrian law.
mystara.rule.felony-limitation-period.blocked_reason: A timed legal expiration is directly representable.

mystara.rule.penalty-for-damage-to-prope.name: Penalty for damage to property

effect.summary: A penalty can remove one body part for each 100 ducats of assessed damage.

mystara.rule.penalty-for-damage-to-prope.cost_or_limit: The assessed damage determines the number of parts removed.
mystara.rule.penalty-for-damage-to-prope.combines: May apply to fingers, tentacles, pseudopods, or similar parts.
mystara.rule.penalty-for-damage-to-prope.blocked_reason: The stated penalty is a proportional cost with a direct bodily consequence.

mystara.rule.misdemeanor-penalties.name: Misdemeanor penalties

effect.summary: Minor offenders may face imprisonment or a fine.

mystara.rule.misdemeanor-penalties.cost_or_limit: One to twelve months in the Tower of Sighs or a 100-ducat fine.

mystara.rule.high-treason.name: High Treason

effect.summary: Violating an oath to the Council of Princes is treated as high treason and punished by death after exposure on the tower.

mystara.rule.high-treason.cost_or_limit: One night of exposure precedes execution.
mystara.rule.high-treason.who_may: Those accused of violating the Council's oath.
mystara.rule.high-treason.blocked_reason: The rule specifies a conventional legal penalty.

mystara.rule.tax-evasion-is-treason.name: Tax evasion is treason

effect.summary: Tax evasion can strip titles, lands, and private wealth and lead to imprisonment.

mystara.rule.tax-evasion-is-treason.cost_or_limit: Imprisonment may last one to ten years.
mystara.rule.tax-evasion-is-treason.go_wrong: Loss of property and status, with possible imprisonment.
mystara.rule.tax-evasion-is-treason.blocked_reason: The rule states legal penalties and property loss.

mystara.rule.mundane-rights-and-burden-o.name: Mundane rights and burden of proof

effect.summary: A mundaner is presumed guilty when the plaintiff is a noble, but otherwise a suspect is presumed innocent.

mystara.rule.mundane-rights-and-burden-o.cost_or_limit: The presumption depends on the plaintiff's social rank.
mystara.rule.mundane-rights-and-burden-o.go_wrong: A mundaner facing a noble plaintiff bears the adverse presumption.
mystara.rule.mundane-rights-and-burden-o.combines: Penalties for misdemeanors do not apply to nobles in their own principalities.
mystara.rule.mundane-rights-and-burden-o.blocked_reason: The rule changes the legal presumption according to a stated condition.

mystara.rule.glantrian-calendar.name: Glantrian calendar

effect.summary: The year has twelve months of 28 days, four seven-day weeks per month, and a lunar cycle of one month.

mystara.rule.glantrian-calendar.cost_or_limit: There are 336 days in a year; full moons rise on the third Lunadain of each month.
mystara.rule.glantrian-calendar.combines: Months begin on Lunadain and end on Soladain.
mystara.rule.glantrian-calendar.blocked_reason: The rule describes a calendar cycle and can be used directly.

mystara.rule.spellcasting-children-must-.name: Spellcasting children must be trained

effect.summary: A spellcasting child who is not sent for required training temporarily loses the ability to cast spells.

mystara.rule.spellcasting-children-must-.cost_or_limit: Training must take place seven days a week for at least eight months per year.
mystara.rule.spellcasting-children-must-.go_wrong: Failure to provide training suspends the child's casting ability until schooling resumes or age sixteen.
mystara.rule.spellcasting-children-must-.combines: Children train at the Great School of Magic.
mystara.rule.spellcasting-children-must-.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward condition that gates an ability.

mystara.rule.child-spell-miscast-chance.name: Child spell miscast chance

effect.summary: A child's spell works normally on a roll no greater than the child's age; a higher roll causes a miscast.

mystara.rule.child-spell-miscast-chance.cost_or_limit: Roll a d20 against the child's age; use a DM-chosen human-age equivalent for an elf child.
mystara.rule.child-spell-miscast-chance.go_wrong: A failed roll produces an unexpected effect without harming the caster.
mystara.rule.child-spell-miscast-chance.mind: Some miscasts affect the targets' minds or memories.
mystara.rule.child-spell-miscast-chance.combines: Miscast outcomes use the Infantile Catastrophe table.
mystara.rule.child-spell-miscast-chance.blocked_reason: The failure can select a variety of uncontrolled effects outside the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.legal-age-for-public-spellc.name: Legal age for public spellcasting

effect.summary: Children under sixteen should not cast spells publicly because of infantile side effects.

mystara.rule.legal-age-for-public-spellc.go_wrong: Younger spellcasters risk infantile spell effects.
mystara.rule.legal-age-for-public-spellc.who_may: People aged sixteen or older may cast publicly without that stated risk.
mystara.rule.legal-age-for-public-spellc.combines: Children are normally NPCs in a Glantrian campaign.
mystara.rule.legal-age-for-public-spellc.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct age-based restriction.

mystara.rule.child-succession-after-a-pa.name: Child succession after a parent's death

effect.summary: A player may take over an NPC child of a deceased character; an NPC parent governs until the child reaches legal age.

mystara.rule.child-succession-after-a-pa.cost_or_limit: The child inherits the level reached at the time the previous character was lost.
mystara.rule.child-succession-after-a-pa.go_wrong: The opportunity depends on the character having achieved nobility or established a family.
mystara.rule.child-succession-after-a-pa.who_may: Players whose lost characters left an eligible child.
mystara.rule.child-succession-after-a-pa.combines: The Council of Princes and Parliament recognize an heir if the couple dies without naming one or cannot agree.
mystara.rule.child-succession-after-a-pa.blocked_reason: The rule describes a playable succession process and conventional governance.

mystara.rule.joint-dominion-consent.name: Joint dominion consent

effect.summary: No decision in a couple's dominion can be made without both nobles' consent.

mystara.rule.joint-dominion-consent.go_wrong: If both die without an agreed heir, recognition passes to the oldest wizardly descendant.
mystara.rule.joint-dominion-consent.combines: The Council of Princes and Parliament recognize the designated descendant.
mystara.rule.joint-dominion-consent.blocked_reason: The rule is an ordinary consent requirement.

mystara.rule.companion-persistence.name: Companion persistence

effect.summary: A summoned companion stays with its master and cannot be dismissed or dispelled.

mystara.rule.companion-persistence.cost_or_limit: A master can have only one such companion at a time.
mystara.rule.companion-persistence.go_wrong: If it dies, the master takes damage equal to its hit points and cannot summon another.
mystara.rule.companion-persistence.mind: The companion is mentally linked to its master.
mystara.rule.companion-persistence.blocked_reason: The companion cannot be dismissed, is mentally linked, and has a death consequence.

mystara.rule.spell-research-requirements.name: Spell research requirements

effect.summary: Spell research requires a large library, components, money, and time.

mystara.rule.spell-research-requirements.cost_or_limit: Costs 1,000 ducats per spell level and takes an initial week plus a day per 1,000 ducats.
mystara.rule.spell-research-requirements.go_wrong: An attempt can fail; spending can be interrupted by running out of funds.
mystara.rule.spell-research-requirements.combines: Components must be obtained before research begins.

mystara.rule.spell-research-success.name: Spell research success

effect.summary: Research chances depend on Intelligence, level, spell level, and whether the spell is new or common.

mystara.rule.spell-research-success.cost_or_limit: New spells impose a greater penalty than common spells; a roll of 93 or more always fails.
mystara.rule.spell-research-success.go_wrong: A failed attempt wastes research effort.

mystara.rule.item-charges-and-recharging.name: Item charges and recharging

effect.summary: Charged items cost extra to enchant; potions and scrolls cannot be recharged.

mystara.rule.item-charges-and-recharging.cost_or_limit: Each charge costs 10% of the initial enchantment; permanent enchantment costs the equivalent of 30 charges.
mystara.rule.item-charges-and-recharging.go_wrong: Items with charges can run out; a creator may make them non-rechargeable for a reduced initial cost.
mystara.rule.item-charges-and-recharging.combines: Different spells on a scroll count as separate items.
mystara.rule.item-charges-and-recharging.blocked_reason: The rule depends on item charge state and whether an item can be recharged.

mystara.rule.item-use-frequency.name: Item use frequency

effect.summary: Items restricted to periodic use have reduced initial enchantment costs, with charges added separately.

mystara.rule.item-use-frequency.cost_or_limit: The reduction depends on whether use is hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly.
mystara.rule.item-use-frequency.combines: Cost also includes charges and the number of uses per period.
mystara.rule.item-use-frequency.blocked_reason: Use depends on tracking a time-based item-use limit.

mystara.rule.multiple-item-powers.name: Multiple item powers

effect.summary: Each power on a multi-effect item is rolled separately; a failed first roll spoils the whole item.

mystara.rule.multiple-item-powers.cost_or_limit: Each effect has its own success roll and cost.
mystara.rule.multiple-item-powers.go_wrong: A failed roll loses the corresponding effect and all not yet rolled for; failure on the first roll spoils the item.
mystara.rule.multiple-item-powers.combines: Multiple separate spell powers can be placed on one item.
mystara.rule.multiple-item-powers.blocked_reason: The rule governs multiple powers carried by a single item and their failure interactions.

mystara.rule.weapon-and-armor-enchantmen.name: Weapon and armor enchantment limits

effect.summary: Weapon and armor bonuses have special cost calculations and are capped at five positive or negative points.

mystara.rule.weapon-and-armor-enchantmen.cost_or_limit: Minimum initial cost is 100 ducats for weapons and 3,000 for armor; daggers count as short swords.
mystara.rule.weapon-and-armor-enchantmen.go_wrong: Extra powers require separate success rolls.
mystara.rule.weapon-and-armor-enchantmen.combines: Extra powers can be added at additional cost.

mystara.rule.school-duel-boundaries-and-.name: School duel boundaries and ending

effect.summary: Duelists must remain inside a 30-inch antimagic circle and may not use physical contact or outside help.

mystara.rule.school-duel-boundaries-and-.cost_or_limit: A duel ends by surrender, clear defeat, or death; breaking the rules or fleeing forfeits it.
mystara.rule.school-duel-boundaries-and-.go_wrong: A surrender feint is forbidden; the winner must immediately dispel attacks against a surrendering opponent.
mystara.rule.school-duel-boundaries-and-.who_may: The two duelists; a jury of ten masters decides ties.
mystara.rule.school-duel-boundaries-and-.combines: The circle protects spectators and prevents leaving by teleportation.
mystara.rule.school-duel-boundaries-and-.blocked_reason: The duel uses a protective antimagic boundary with enforced entry and exit restrictions.

mystara.rule.intelligent-weapon-creation.name: Intelligent weapon creation

effect.summary: Intelligent weapons are deliberately made only by Immortals; a wizard's magical sword may independently turn out intelligent.

mystara.rule.intelligent-weapon-creation.cost_or_limit: Intelligence is checked when a wizard makes a magical sword.
mystara.rule.intelligent-weapon-creation.blocked_reason: This is a world rule about item creation, not a special effect.

mystara.rule.enchantment-interruption-pe.name: Enchantment interruption penalty

effect.summary: A DM may reduce success chances by five percent for each interruption, regardless of how long it lasts.

mystara.rule.enchantment-interruption-pe.cost_or_limit: Only interruption count matters; the wizard may still adventure to meet research costs.
mystara.rule.enchantment-interruption-pe.who_may: Applies to wizard spell research and enchantment.
mystara.rule.enchantment-interruption-pe.blocked_reason: A basic success-check procedure can implement the stated penalty.

mystara.rule.secret-order-advancement.name: Secret-order advancement

effect.summary: Orders have five circles; members must learn each circle's abilities before advancing, and the fifth-circle ability is won by defeating the High Master.

mystara.rule.secret-order-advancement.cost_or_limit: Study requires fees, time, Intelligence checks, and specified experience earned using the new ability; failed checks may require restarting study.
mystara.rule.secret-order-advancement.go_wrong: A failed study check means starting that ability's study again; a defeated challenger retains existing abilities but must leave the order.
mystara.rule.secret-order-advancement.who_may: Accepted disciples who meet circle level requirements.
mystara.rule.secret-order-advancement.where_from: Secret orders of the Great School of Magic.
mystara.rule.secret-order-advancement.combines: An ability's success chance is halved until required experience has been accumulated.
mystara.rule.secret-order-advancement.mechanism: Rank progression with training and challenge
mystara.rule.secret-order-advancement.blocked_reason: The rule is a progression and success-check procedure.

mystara.rule.alchemical-laboratory-requi.name: Alchemical laboratory requirements

effect.summary: Alchemical experiments require a laboratory and uninterrupted work; only one experiment may be attempted at once.

mystara.rule.alchemical-laboratory-requi.cost_or_limit: A full lab costs 3,000 gp per circle, with a special 25,000 gp High Master lab; components also require replacement costs. Field kits are limited-use and only support work through the third circle.
mystara.rule.alchemical-laboratory-requi.go_wrong: Each brief interruption imposes a five-percent failure chance.
mystara.rule.alchemical-laboratory-requi.combines: Field laboratories halve success chances and run out after ten uses.
mystara.rule.alchemical-laboratory-requi.blocked_reason: The requirements and limits can be represented as equipment and checks.

mystara.rule.lich-advancement-limit.name: Lich advancement limit

effect.summary: A character who becomes a lich cannot gain further levels.

mystara.rule.lich-advancement-limit.combines: The passage says true immortality may still be pursued only with the Sphere of Entropy.

mystara.rule.necromancer-lich-uniqueness.name: Necromancer lich uniqueness

effect.summary: Only one necromancer lich, the High Master, can exist at a time.

mystara.rule.necromancer-lich-uniqueness.combines: Other liches may exist in the world.

mystara.rule.radiance-corruption.name: Radiance corruption

effect.summary: Each Radiance-related spell has a 1% chance to permanently rot a randomly selected body part.

mystara.rule.radiance-corruption.cost_or_limit: The chance is checked for every related spell; a fully affected body turns the user into a lich at level 21 or higher, otherwise a lich-like creature.
mystara.rule.radiance-corruption.go_wrong: Rotting parts cannot be healed and cease to function; the user may enter mindless limbo.
mystara.rule.radiance-corruption.mind: The Radiance can corrupt the mind as well as the body.
mystara.rule.radiance-corruption.combines: Repeated corruption can transform the whole body.
mystara.rule.radiance-corruption.blocked_reason: It imposes persistent, cumulative bodily and mental deterioration.

mystara.rule.radiance-magic-drain.name: Radiance magic drain

effect.summary: Every use of the Nucleus permanently drains magic from the Prime Material Plane.

mystara.rule.radiance-magic-drain.cost_or_limit: The decline depends on total annual rads drained and average active brethren; thresholds produce outages, scarcity, extinction of magical beings, societal collapse, and eventual cataclysm.
mystara.rule.radiance-magic-drain.go_wrong: At 3,000 rad force, the artifact explodes and destroys Glantri in a cataclysm.
mystara.rule.radiance-magic-drain.who_may: Triggered whenever the artifact is used.
mystara.rule.radiance-magic-drain.combines: The Brotherhood's active membership and annual rad use determine symptoms.
mystara.rule.radiance-magic-drain.blocked_reason: It is a cumulative, world-scale resource drain with escalating consequences.

mystara.rule.nucleus-radiation.name: Nucleus radiation

effect.summary: Living beings in the Nucleus cave must save against poison each round of exposure.

mystara.rule.nucleus-radiation.cost_or_limit: After leaving, the save penalty worsens by one per round of exposure; failure causes death after 2d4 weeks unless cured by wish or high-level healing.
mystara.rule.nucleus-radiation.go_wrong: Failed saves cause fatal, persistent radiation sickness.
mystara.rule.nucleus-radiation.who_may: Any living being entering the cave
mystara.rule.nucleus-radiation.where_from: Cave beneath the Great School of Magic
mystara.rule.nucleus-radiation.combines: A wish or high-level healing spell cures the sickness.

mystara.rule.time-travel-paradox.name: Time-travel paradox

effect.summary: Destroying an earlier version of a traveler erases the later version from existence.

mystara.rule.time-travel-paradox.cost_or_limit: The same character at an earlier date is the target of the rule.
mystara.rule.time-travel-paradox.combines: Changing the artifact's past can alter Glantri's history.
mystara.rule.time-travel-paradox.blocked_reason: It changes a character's existence across time rather than applying a basic effect.

mystara.rule.blackball-confinement.name: Blackball confinement

effect.summary: A magical constraint prevents the blackball from leaving the vault.

mystara.rule.blackball-confinement.cost_or_limit: The creature is confined to the vault.
mystara.rule.blackball-confinement.combines: The magic is linked to the vault’s ward.
mystara.rule.blackball-confinement.blocked_reason: The passage states that magic physically prevents a creature from leaving an area.

mystara.rule.graduation-test-key-ring.name: Graduation-test key ring

effect.summary: The ring’s keys appear and disappear as the student enters and exits areas, but remain attached to the ring.

mystara.rule.graduation-test-key-ring.cost_or_limit: Keys cannot be discarded, and the ring cannot be used to bypass the final doors.
mystara.rule.graduation-test-key-ring.go_wrong: A student stuck in a passage may be teleported or released by a one-way door.
mystara.rule.graduation-test-key-ring.where_from: The Great School of Magic test dungeon
mystara.rule.graduation-test-key-ring.combines: Key availability depends on area symbols and the ring.
mystara.rule.graduation-test-key-ring.mechanism: Bound item with triggered key state
mystara.rule.graduation-test-key-ring.blocked_reason: The key ring changes which keys are available in response to location and cannot be separated from them.

mystara.rule.mandragora-uprooting-hazard.name: Mandragora uprooting hazard

effect.summary: Uprooting a mandragora risks death unless the harvester succeeds at a save.

mystara.rule.mandragora-uprooting-hazard.cost_or_limit: The harvester must save against a death spell.
mystara.rule.mandragora-uprooting-hazard.combines: Tying the root to a dog lets the root be picked up safely after the dog dies.

effect.summary: A graduating student retains useful items found in the numbered areas.

mystara.rule.imp-soul-recovery.name: Imp soul recovery

effect.summary: A victim who dies under an imp’s contract cannot be revived by any means; destroying the contract is the sole recourse.

mystara.rule.imp-soul-recovery.cost_or_limit: The imp and contract must be found.
mystara.rule.imp-soul-recovery.go_wrong: The victim is otherwise irrecoverable after death.
mystara.rule.imp-soul-recovery.who_may: Victims bound by an imp contract
mystara.rule.imp-soul-recovery.combines: The imp may help the victim indirectly while the contract remains.
mystara.rule.imp-soul-recovery.blocked_reason: The rule specifies the soul’s unrecoverable state after death and a contract-based exception.

mystara.rule.manikin-spiritual-tie.name: Manikin spiritual tie

effect.summary: A manikin must stay within 100 feet of one fixed, immovable spiritual tie for its life, and that location cannot change.

mystara.rule.manikin-spiritual-tie.cost_or_limit: The tie point is fixed permanently; the manikin remains within 100 feet.
mystara.rule.manikin-spiritual-tie.mind: The creator controls the manikin mentally and can read its thoughts and memories.
mystara.rule.manikin-spiritual-tie.combines: The creator’s death or the manikin’s destruction ends the manikin’s life.
mystara.rule.manikin-spiritual-tie.blocked_reason: The creature is persistently bound to a creator and an immovable location.

mystara.rule.manikin-death-harms-creator.name: Manikin death harms creator

effect.summary: When a manikin dies, its creator permanently loses hit points equal to the manikin’s hit points.

mystara.rule.manikin-death-harms-creator.cost_or_limit: Loss equals the manikin’s hit points.
mystara.rule.manikin-death-harms-creator.go_wrong: The creator suffers permanent hit-point loss.
mystara.rule.manikin-death-harms-creator.blocked_reason: The rule applies a lasting effect to the creator when a separate bound creature dies.

mystara.rule.wilderness-park-hunting-lic.name: Wilderness park hunting licenses

effect.summary: Hunting and access in the protected parks require government authorization, with fees and permits varying by duration and species.

mystara.rule.wilderness-park-hunting-lic.cost_or_limit: License price and term vary by species and duration.
mystara.rule.wilderness-park-hunting-lic.go_wrong: Unlicensed access or hunting violates park restrictions.
mystara.rule.wilderness-park-hunting-lic.combines: Customs levies an export surcharge on taken creatures
mystara.rule.wilderness-park-hunting-lic.blocked_reason: The rule governs permission and access rather than an effect supported by the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.albino-builders-eternal-lif.name: Albino builders’ eternal life

effect.summary: A particularly well-designed structure is believed to earn its builder eternal life in the patron Immortal’s world.

mystara.rule.albino-builders-eternal-lif.cost_or_limit: The belief applies to especially well-designed buildings.
mystara.rule.albino-builders-eternal-lif.combines: Connects architecture to an afterlife reward
mystara.rule.albino-builders-eternal-lif.blocked_reason: The rule depends on a character’s post-death soul and afterlife destination.

mystara.rule.albino-construction-substan.name: Albino construction substance

effect.summary: A secret substance makes sand constructions hard like stone.

mystara.rule.albino-construction-substan.cost_or_limit: Only spiritual gurus know the recipe and cannot be forced to reveal it.
mystara.rule.albino-construction-substan.go_wrong: Gurus may voluntarily die rather than disclose the method.
mystara.rule.albino-construction-substan.combines: Applied to sand structures, often decorated with shells and coral
mystara.rule.albino-construction-substan.mechanism: Material hardening through a secret compound
mystara.rule.albino-construction-substan.blocked_reason: The passage leaves the compound and the material transformation process unspecified.

mystara.rule.weapon-dipping-concoction.name: Weapon-dipping concoction

effect.summary: Weapons treated with the substance can paralyze victims for hours, while mortal wounds can turn victims to stone.

mystara.rule.weapon-dipping-concoction.cost_or_limit: A mortal wound is needed for petrification; lesser effects last several hours.
mystara.rule.weapon-dipping-concoction.go_wrong: Victims may be permanently petrified by a mortal wound.
mystara.rule.weapon-dipping-concoction.combines: Weapons are treated with the albinos’ secret concoction
mystara.rule.weapon-dipping-concoction.blocked_reason: The effect is carried by treated weapons and distinguishes outcomes by wound severity.

mystara.rule.whitenight-abbey-population.name: Whitenight Abbey population replacement

effect.summary: When an Abbey member dies, a child apparently appears to replace that individual, keeping the community’s numbers constant.

mystara.rule.whitenight-abbey-population.cost_or_limit: The replacement occurs despite mortality and no apparent mothers.
mystara.rule.whitenight-abbey-population.mechanism: Unexplained birth or replacement after death
mystara.rule.whitenight-abbey-population.blocked_reason: The rule links death to a seemingly spontaneous replacement person without explaining the mechanism.

mystara.rule.ethereal-isolation-of-orisi.name: Ethereal isolation of Orisis’s followers

effect.summary: Orisis’s chosen followers are forbidden from speaking with beings outside their Ethereal Plane refuge.

mystara.rule.ethereal-isolation-of-orisi.cost_or_limit: They must not communicate with outsiders.
mystara.rule.ethereal-isolation-of-orisi.combines: Maintains the secrecy of Nithian wrongdoing
mystara.rule.ethereal-isolation-of-orisi.blocked_reason: The text states a continuing prohibition but does not explain its enforcing mechanism.

mystara.rule.white-island-dream-visions.name: White Island dream visions

effect.summary: Exposure to the island’s visions can leave victims insane in a twilight state between waking and dreaming.

mystara.rule.white-island-dream-visions.cost_or_limit: A saving throw is required; short stays may be recoverable with rest and clerical help.
mystara.rule.white-island-dream-visions.go_wrong: Longer exposure can leave lasting insanity.
mystara.rule.white-island-dream-visions.combines: Associated with the white apes and the island’s supernatural presence
mystara.rule.white-island-dream-visions.blocked_reason: The effect has variable duration, progressive severity, and recovery conditions not expressed by the basic grammar.

mystara.rule.elven-natural-lifespan.name: Elven natural lifespan

effect.summary: Elves commonly live 600–900 years; a few reach 1,000, though disease and violence can kill them earlier.

mystara.rule.elven-natural-lifespan.cost_or_limit: Typical life spans range from 600 to 900 years.
mystara.rule.elven-natural-lifespan.go_wrong: Disease or violence can cause earlier death.
mystara.rule.elven-natural-lifespan.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as a lifespan limit with ordinary causes of death.

mystara.rule.alfheim-clerical-service.name: Alfheim clerical service

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.alfheim-clerical-service.cost_or_limit: A cleric living in Alfheim must provide designated raise-dead services free of charge.
mystara.rule.alfheim-clerical-service.who_may: Clerics who wish to live in Alfheim and can raise the dead.
mystara.rule.alfheim-clerical-service.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward service obligation.

mystara.rule.elven-property-customs.name: Elven property customs

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.elven-property-customs.cost_or_limit: Elves generally regard usable personal possessions as property, but land and people are not normally owned; clan boundaries are imprecise.
mystara.rule.elven-property-customs.blocked_reason: This describes social rules about ownership.

mystara.rule.elven-crimes.name: Elven crimes

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.elven-crimes.cost_or_limit: The listed crimes are theft of personal property, harming or killing another, damaging clan property, and trying to destroy the forest.

mystara.rule.elven-punishment.name: Elven punishment

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.elven-punishment.cost_or_limit: Victims' friends decide justice for individual crimes; deliberate arson against the forest merits death, while other destruction brings reparations or possible exile.
mystara.rule.elven-punishment.blocked_reason: This is a social justice procedure.

mystara.rule.alfheim-town-orc-parole.name: Alfheim Town orc parole

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.alfheim-town-orc-parole.cost_or_limit: The elves offered the enslaved orcs parole; most left, while 67 were permitted to remain.
mystara.rule.alfheim-town-orc-parole.who_may: Orcs held as slave labor in town
mystara.rule.alfheim-town-orc-parole.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward status and residency rule.

effect.summary: Elven stronghold population stays constant except when people are lost to disaster or battle.
A clan’s representatives cannot exceed the number of elves its assigned rooms can house.
An elven arrow has a 10% chance of breaking after each use.

mystara.rule.stronghold-income.name: Stronghold income

effect.summary: A basic stronghold receives 10 gp standard income and about 2 gp resource income per family each month.

mystara.rule.stronghold-income.cost_or_limit: Income depends on family count and resource production.
mystara.rule.stronghold-income.combines: Income categories are standard and resource income.

mystara.rule.stronghold-expenses.name: Stronghold expenses

effect.summary: Only 10% of stronghold income is paid to the Clan; visits have stated hospitality costs.
