mystara.rule.stronghold-expenses.cost_or_limit: 10% of income; visitor expenses also apply.

mystara.rule.elf-minimum-intelligence.name: Elf minimum Intelligence

effect.summary: An elf character needs Intelligence 9 or higher.

mystara.rule.elf-minimum-intelligence.cost_or_limit: Characters below the minimum must be rerolled.
mystara.rule.elf-minimum-intelligence.blocked_reason: A character-generation threshold is a simple rule.

mystara.rule.elf-experience-bonuses.name: Elf experience bonuses

effect.summary: High Strength and Intelligence grant experience bonuses of 5% or 10%.

mystara.rule.elf-experience-bonuses.cost_or_limit: The 5% bonus requires both scores at least 13; the 10% bonus requires Intelligence 16+ and Strength 13+.
mystara.rule.elf-experience-bonuses.blocked_reason: A numeric experience modifier is a simple rule.

mystara.rule.elf-hit-dice-and-level-limi.name: Elf hit dice and level limit

effect.summary: Elves gain d6 hit dice through ninth level, then two hit points per level without a Constitution bonus; normal maximum level is 10.

mystara.rule.elf-hit-dice-and-level-limi.cost_or_limit: Special human training can extend fighting ability, but not hit dice.
mystara.rule.elf-hit-dice-and-level-limi.combines: Magic study with Treekeepers can extend spell command.
mystara.rule.elf-hit-dice-and-level-limi.blocked_reason: The progression limits and increments are simple rules.

mystara.rule.elven-spell-restrictions.name: Elven spell restrictions

effect.summary: Elves who do not study with Treekeepers cannot learn beyond fifth-level spells, and elves cannot access killing spells.

mystara.rule.elven-spell-restrictions.cost_or_limit: Death, disintegrate, and power words are unavailable to elves.
mystara.rule.elven-spell-restrictions.combines: Treekeeper study can increase magical command, but access differs from human magic-users.
mystara.rule.elven-spell-restrictions.blocked_reason: A restriction on spell access can be directly implemented.

mystara.rule.elven-enemy-languages.name: Elven enemy languages

effect.summary: Elves naturally learn gnoll, orc, and hobgoblin languages.

mystara.rule.elven-enemy-languages.blocked_reason: A language proficiency is a directly representable character capability.

mystara.rule.skill-check.name: Skill check

effect.summary: A skill succeeds when a d20 roll is no greater than its governing ability; a 20 always fails.

mystara.rule.skill-check.cost_or_limit: Roll against the relevant ability score; natural 20 fails.
mystara.rule.skill-check.go_wrong: A failed check means the attempted skill use fails.
mystara.rule.skill-check.combines: Skill scores can be improved by trading skill choices.
mystara.rule.skill-check.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure rather than a world mechanism.

mystara.rule.skill-advancement.name: Skill advancement

effect.summary: Characters gain new skill choices at stated experience levels and may spend a choice to improve an existing skill by one.

mystara.rule.skill-advancement.cost_or_limit: Elves gain skill choices at levels 1, 5, and 9, then at specified experience thresholds.
mystara.rule.skill-advancement.who_may: Characters using the optional skill system.
mystara.rule.skill-advancement.combines: A choice buys a new skill or improves one skill.
mystara.rule.skill-advancement.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure rather than a world mechanism.

mystara.rule.chevall-weapon-vulnerabilit.name: Chevall weapon vulnerability

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.chevall-weapon-vulnerabilit.cost_or_limit: Chevalls can be hit only by silver or magical weapons.
mystara.rule.chevall-weapon-vulnerabilit.blocked_reason: A weapon vulnerability restriction can be handled as a game rule.

mystara.rule.magic-points.name: Magic Points

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.magic-points.cost_or_limit: Can appear anywhere and at any time; only the most stable and long-lasting ones are mapped.
mystara.rule.magic-points.go_wrong: May transport travelers into a swamp or other perilous setting.
mystara.rule.magic-points.combines: May warp time or lead elsewhere.
mystara.rule.magic-points.blocked_reason: Unpredictable displacement and time warping require spatial and temporal mechanisms beyond the basic grammar.

mystara.rule.magic-point-changes.name: Magic point changes

effect.summary: Magic points can change a character's sex or race until corrected.

mystara.rule.magic-point-changes.cost_or_limit: Such changes should be temporary or correctable through appropriate events.
mystara.rule.magic-point-changes.go_wrong: Permanent unwanted changes can frustrate players.
mystara.rule.magic-point-changes.who_may: Characters affected by a magic point.
mystara.rule.magic-point-changes.where_from: Magic points outside Alfheim may produce similar effects.
mystara.rule.magic-point-changes.blocked_reason: Changing a character's race or sex requires body transformation beyond the basic grammar.

mystara.rule.wormhole-transit.name: Wormhole transit

effect.summary: A wormhole transports travelers through the Sphere of Entropy to the Broken Lands.

mystara.rule.wormhole-transit.cost_or_limit: Interplanar travel requires preparation to survive.
mystara.rule.wormhole-transit.go_wrong: Unprepared travelers simply die unless they make the specified saving throw.
mystara.rule.wormhole-transit.where_from: A tunnel reached from the Bad Magic Point.
mystara.rule.wormhole-transit.combines: The route back is more pleasant and takes a different path.
mystara.rule.wormhole-transit.blocked_reason: The described transport and death risk can be represented with basic movement and an end effect.

mystara.rule.dwarven-resistance-to-sorce.name: Dwarven resistance to sorcery

effect.summary: Dwarves, especially older and more experienced ones, resist sorcery.

mystara.rule.dwarven-resistance-to-sorce.cost_or_limit: Resistance is particularly associated with age and experience.
mystara.rule.dwarven-resistance-to-sorce.where_from: Dwarven nature, unexplained in the passage
mystara.rule.dwarven-resistance-to-sorce.blocked_reason: The passage gives no mechanics for how resistance interacts with specific spells.

mystara.rule.dwarven-magical-item-crafti.name: Dwarven magical-item crafting requirements

effect.summary: A dwarf-craftsman must meet a high level threshold, have a relevant craft skill, and access suitable tools and materials to make a magical item.

mystara.rule.dwarven-magical-item-crafti.cost_or_limit: Requires at least 12th level, relevant skill, workshops, tools, and materials; creation consumes time, money, and the maker's experience.
mystara.rule.dwarven-magical-item-crafti.combines: Enchantment can involve a magic-user for spell-effect enchantments.
mystara.rule.dwarven-magical-item-crafti.blocked_reason: The passage gives constraints on a crafting process rather than an unsupported effect.

mystara.rule.dwarven-craftmagic-enchantm.name: Dwarven craftmagic enchantment division

effect.summary: The dwarf pays experience for weapon or armor bonuses, while spell-effect enchantments cost gold and require a magic-user's success roll.

mystara.rule.dwarven-craftmagic-enchantm.cost_or_limit: Forge use halves time only; gold and experience costs stay unchanged.
mystara.rule.dwarven-craftmagic-enchantm.go_wrong: Enchantment may fail on the relevant skill or magic-user roll.
mystara.rule.dwarven-craftmagic-enchantm.who_may: A dwarf-craftsman and, for spell effects, a magic-user
mystara.rule.dwarven-craftmagic-enchantm.combines: Forge of power can reduce crafting time.
mystara.rule.dwarven-craftmagic-enchantm.mechanism: Separated costs and skill checks for enchantment
mystara.rule.dwarven-craftmagic-enchantm.blocked_reason: Magical item creation and embedded spell effects require rules beyond the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.denwarf-s-spell-resistance.name: Denwarf’s spell resistance

effect.summary: Denwarf automatically suffers only half damage from spell effects.

mystara.rule.denwarf-s-spell-resistance.blocked_reason: A numerical reduction to incoming spell damage fits the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.giants-and-dwarves-can-slee.name: Giants and dwarves can sleep as stone

effect.summary: Some earth-connected dwarves and giants become immobile and blend into surrounding earth or rock.

mystara.rule.giants-and-dwarves-can-slee.cost_or_limit: The passage associates the ability with close connection to earth.
mystara.rule.giants-and-dwarves-can-slee.combines: Their resting bodies are hard to distinguish from the terrain.
mystara.rule.giants-and-dwarves-can-slee.blocked_reason: The described change into terrain-like immobility requires a form or body-state capability beyond the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.kobold-succession.name: Kobold succession

effect.summary: Kobold unity often ends within a few years after a heroic leader's death.

mystara.rule.kobold-succession.cost_or_limit: Leadership's influence seldom outlasts the leader.
mystara.rule.kobold-succession.blocked_reason: This is a social limit, not a supernatural effect.

mystara.rule.kobold-oral-transmission.name: Kobold oral transmission

effect.summary: Kobold civilization is precarious because its traditions are transmitted orally.

mystara.rule.kobold-oral-transmission.cost_or_limit: Knowledge is vulnerable to disruption when transmission fails.
mystara.rule.kobold-oral-transmission.combines: Some kobolds learn written languages and arithmetic.
mystara.rule.kobold-oral-transmission.blocked_reason: This describes how cultural knowledge persists.

mystara.rule.poisoned-quarrel-duration.name: Poisoned quarrel duration

effect.summary: The poison on the kobolds' quarrels remains potent for only five; the unit is missing.

mystara.rule.poisoned-quarrel-duration.go_wrong: Its potency expires after the stated but unreadable interval.
mystara.rule.poisoned-quarrel-duration.blocked_reason: A duration limit can be tracked as a game rule.

mystara.rule.kobold-withdrawal-strategy.name: Kobold withdrawal strategy

effect.summary: Kobolds avoid major engagements and casualties by using terrain and withdrawing.

mystara.rule.kobold-withdrawal-strategy.cost_or_limit: They avoid certain dangerous routes, including ant colonies.
mystara.rule.kobold-withdrawal-strategy.combines: Uses cover, narrow passages, flank attacks, and underwater routes.
mystara.rule.kobold-withdrawal-strategy.blocked_reason: The strategy is a set of ordinary tactical choices.

mystara.rule.runes.name: Runes

effect.summary: Runes can identify belongings and provide magical enhancements, but a rune's function may be altered permanently.

mystara.rule.runes.cost_or_limit: The book warns against allowing rune effects to unbalance the setting.
mystara.rule.runes.go_wrong: A changed rune may never work as it did before.
mystara.rule.runes.combines: May be associated with personal belongings and magical enhancements.
mystara.rule.runes.blocked_reason: The passage describes lasting magical functions attached to runes and objects.

mystara.rule.asgard-access.name: Asgard access

effect.summary: The only route to Asgard is through the Outer Plane.

mystara.rule.asgard-access.cost_or_limit: Access requires reaching the Outer Plane.
mystara.rule.asgard-access.who_may: Travelers using the stated planar route.
mystara.rule.asgard-access.combines: The passage also mentions clerical plane travel, plane shift, gate, or a suitable artifact.
mystara.rule.asgard-access.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward restriction on travel between planes.

mystara.rule.weregild.name: Weregild

effect.summary: A mutually agreed payment compensates for injury; paying it requires vengeance to be abandoned.

mystara.rule.weregild.go_wrong: Failure to settle can sustain vengeance
mystara.rule.weregild.blocked_reason: This is a social rule that can be adjudicated directly.

mystara.rule.outlawing.name: Outlawing

effect.summary: A person convicted of especially grave offenses may be banished from a clan domain or wider region and barred from returning.

mystara.rule.outlawing.cost_or_limit: Reserved for severe crimes such as kinslaying or betrayal
mystara.rule.outlawing.go_wrong: A ruler may abuse treason accusations to expel an enemy
mystara.rule.outlawing.combines: May extend across multiple domains or a nation
mystara.rule.outlawing.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct social restriction on a person’s permitted location.

mystara.rule.the-spirit-remains-with-the.name: The spirit remains with the body for 4d6 hours.

effect.summary: A dead person's spirit remains with the corpse for 4d6 hours before departing.

mystara.rule.the-spirit-remains-with-the.blocked_reason: It specifies the persistence and departure of a dead person's spirit.

mystara.rule.each-use-of-the-rune-spell-.name: Each use of the rune spell results in the permanent loss of one Constitution point.

effect.summary: Rune learning permanently reduces the cleric's Constitution by one point each time.

mystara.rule.each-use-of-the-rune-spell-.go_wrong: The ritual's near-suicidal dangers include possible death.

mystara.rule.yallara.name: Yallara

effect.summary: A restless period of self-discovery ends when a hin finds what they want to do in life.

mystara.rule.yallara.cost_or_limit: Usually begins in adolescence; duration varies from a few seasons to many decades.
mystara.rule.yallara.mind: Involves questioning one’s identity, pursuits, and society.

mystara.rule.clan-loyalty.name: Clan loyalty

effect.summary: A halfling who knows clan kinship will not knowingly harm their own clan unless under magical compulsion or similar control.

mystara.rule.clan-loyalty.cost_or_limit: Yallaren are effectively exempt from the overriding rule, though their clan attachment remains instinctive.
mystara.rule.clan-loyalty.go_wrong: Magical compulsion can override the normal restraint.
mystara.rule.clan-loyalty.mind: Strong loyalty constrains deliberate action against one’s clan.
mystara.rule.clan-loyalty.who_may: Halflings with experience of clan kinship.
mystara.rule.clan-loyalty.combines: Charm magic treats betrayal of one’s clan as contrary to the victim’s nature; Denial may help evade such influence.
mystara.rule.clan-loyalty.blocked_reason: The rule describes a powerful mental constraint and its interaction with magical compulsion.

mystara.rule.clan-founding-limit.name: Clan founding limit

effect.summary: There can be no more than one hundred clans; a new one may be founded only after an existing clan is certainly extinct.

mystara.rule.clan-founding-limit.cost_or_limit: Two halfling Sheriffs must know the extinction is certain, and the prospective founder must not have caused it.
mystara.rule.clan-founding-limit.who_may: A suitably accomplished halfling founder, subject to the restrictions.

mystara.rule.clan-ranks.name: Clan ranks

effect.summary: Influence and rank determine a hin’s standing, duties, and authority within a clan.

mystara.rule.clan-ranks.cost_or_limit: Rank advancement depends on influence, age, inheritance, vote, or service, as applicable.
mystara.rule.clan-ranks.go_wrong: False claims of rank lead to social avoidance and possible non-serious restraint.
mystara.rule.clan-ranks.combines: Influence can let a halfling speak and act as if one rank higher; offices have defined authority and succession.

mystara.rule.influence-points.name: Influence Points

effect.summary: Good deeds and responsible use of rank earn points that measure clan influence and can support advancement.

mystara.rule.influence-points.cost_or_limit: The DM awards variable points for rank duties, good deeds, and great deeds; self-serving acts earn little.
mystara.rule.influence-points.go_wrong: Reckless deeds that endanger clan or companions should be rewarded little.
mystara.rule.influence-points.mind: Motivation and regard for others affect awards.
mystara.rule.influence-points.who_may: Halfling characters involved in clan life.
mystara.rule.influence-points.where_from: Clan customs of the Five Shires.
mystara.rule.influence-points.combines: Influence determines aid expected from and owed to the clan, and can affect pecking order.

mystara.rule.denial-cost-and-scope.name: Denial cost and scope

effect.summary: Denial can affect only a magical effect the hin is aware of, not a purely physical threat or hidden attack.

mystara.rule.denial-cost-and-scope.cost_or_limit: It works only in the Five Shires, once every 24 hours, and its user loses 1–4 hit points; it occupies the user’s attention for the round and lasts through the next round.
mystara.rule.denial-cost-and-scope.go_wrong: Hit point loss may kill the user, and the attempt may fail or only partly hinder the effect.
mystara.rule.denial-cost-and-scope.where_from: The land’s inherent forces, or Blackflame nearby.
mystara.rule.denial-cost-and-scope.combines: Attempts by multiple hin do not stack; artifact effects penalize the denial score; negated spells and item charges are still expended.
mystara.rule.denial-cost-and-scope.blocked_reason: The rule includes resolution that weakens, redirects, cancels, or reflects another power.

mystara.rule.hin-criminal-sentencing.name: Hin criminal sentencing

effect.summary: Offenders may be cast out, punished, sent on quests or services, or executed; completing a sentence quest restores stripped rank or office.

mystara.rule.hin-criminal-sentencing.cost_or_limit: A hin who intentionally cripples another must pay for the healing used to restore the victim.

mystara.rule.smuggling-exception.name: Smuggling exception

effect.summary: The Sheriffs tolerate smuggling goods into or out of the Shires beyond approved amounts.

mystara.rule.smuggling-exception.cost_or_limit: The exception concerns goods traded beyond the quantities approved by the Sheriffs.

mystara.rule.sheriff-eligibility-and-sel.name: Sheriff eligibility and selection

effect.summary: Sheriffs privately investigate candidates and invite their chosen candidate to office.

mystara.rule.sheriff-eligibility-and-sel.cost_or_limit: A candidate must be a halfling of at least 8th level with distinguished service as a Knight-Hero or Acting Clan-Chief.
mystara.rule.sheriff-eligibility-and-sel.who_may: Any hin may propose a candidate; the Sheriffs choose.
mystara.rule.sheriff-eligibility-and-sel.combines: The clan receives a formal invitation if the candidate accepts.

mystara.rule.leaving-office.name: Leaving Office

effect.summary: A Sheriff may freely renounce office before at least two other Sheriffs.

mystara.rule.leaving-office.cost_or_limit: The renunciation is made in the presence of at least two Sheriffs.
mystara.rule.leaving-office.combines: Ex-Sheriffs rejoin their clans as Knight-Heroes or become Masters.

mystara.rule.sheriffs-authority-and-coun.name: Sheriffs’ authority and council

effect.summary: Sheriffs settle disputes across clans and involving clanless hin or non-citizens; they vote when a council decision is needed.

mystara.rule.sheriffs-authority-and-coun.cost_or_limit: Each Sheriff administers one of the five Shires; council decisions are decided by vote.
mystara.rule.sheriffs-authority-and-coun.combines: A Sheriff may call a council when a matter affects the wider Shires.

mystara.rule.sheriff-s-rods-and-authorit.name: Sheriff’s rods and authority

effect.summary: A Sheriff may requisition goods, but ordinarily does so only to seize stolen material or evidence, or by asking clan leaders or Keepers.

mystara.rule.sheriff-s-rods-and-authorit.cost_or_limit: Each Sheriff has a summer treasury of 10,000 gold pieces for personal use.
mystara.rule.sheriff-s-rods-and-authorit.go_wrong: Abusing the office is treated as dishonorable.
mystara.rule.sheriff-s-rods-and-authorit.combines: Sheriffs are watched by the High Heroes.

mystara.rule.sheriff-s-term-and-resignat.name: Sheriff’s term and resignation

effect.summary: Sheriffs serve as long as they wish; typical service lasts six or seven years, with some serving longer.

mystara.rule.sheriff-s-term-and-resignat.cost_or_limit: A Sheriff may leave office freely, before at least two other Sheriffs.
mystara.rule.sheriff-s-term-and-resignat.combines: On leaving, an ex-Sheriff typically becomes a Knight-Hero or Master.

mystara.rule.arrows-of-justice-activatio.name: Arrows of Justice activation and effects

effect.summary: A halfling can throw an arrow at a visible target; it may damage, root the target, or do both, and leaves a glow that defeats hiding and invisibility.

mystara.rule.arrows-of-justice-activatio.cost_or_limit: It vanishes after striking; rooting lasts 2–5 rounds, damage is 2–12 points with a save for half, and the glow lasts 3–18 rounds.
mystara.rule.arrows-of-justice-activatio.go_wrong: It does not activate against an illusion and falls unused.
mystara.rule.arrows-of-justice-activatio.mind: The thrower mentally chooses the effects on release; absent command, it deals damage.
mystara.rule.arrows-of-justice-activatio.where_from: Made by Hin Masters and Keepers under human mage guidance.
mystara.rule.arrows-of-justice-activatio.mechanism: magical projectile, restraint, and detection mark

mystara.rule.finite-exile.name: Finite exile

effect.summary: Limited banishment is a common sentence for hin.

mystara.rule.finite-exile.who_may: Sheriffs may impose it on hin offenders.

mystara.rule.hin-runes.name: Hin runes

effect.summary: Written signs convey directions, warnings, and information about hazards, sites, and treasures.

mystara.rule.hin-runes.cost_or_limit: Some meanings and origins are lost; runes can be combined, with one usually emphasized.
mystara.rule.hin-runes.who_may: Hin taught by an Elder or parent know the presented signs; they may teach visitors.
mystara.rule.hin-runes.where_from: Old halfling practice; found in mines and other sites.
mystara.rule.hin-runes.combines: Multiple signs make a combined message.

mystara.rule.platinum-coin-exchange-valu.name: Platinum coin exchange value

effect.summary: Accepted platinum coins count as ten gold pieces.

mystara.rule.platinum-coin-exchange-valu.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward exchange rule.

mystara.rule.master-spell-recovery.name: Master spell recovery

effect.summary: Masters cannot regain spells beyond the Shires' borders until they become Higher Masters.

mystara.rule.master-spell-recovery.cost_or_limit: Higher Masters may travel and regain spells outside the Shires.
mystara.rule.master-spell-recovery.blocked_reason: A location restriction on recovery is directly implementable.

mystara.rule.blackflame-immunity.name: Blackflame immunity

effect.summary: Only those of full halfling blood are immune to Blackflame’s harmful effects.

mystara.rule.blackflame-immunity.blocked_reason: This is a direct damage restriction.

mystara.rule.blackflame-containment-and-.name: Blackflame containment and reserves

effect.summary: Clans keep hidden reserve flames, and each is disclosed only to a single Witness besides the Keeper.

mystara.rule.blackflame-containment-and-.cost_or_limit: The Keeper knows the locations of all reserves; each Witness knows only one.
mystara.rule.blackflame-containment-and-.combines: Reserves protect against damage, theft, or destruction of the main Crucible.
mystara.rule.blackflame-containment-and-.mechanism: Redundant hidden stores with restricted access.
mystara.rule.blackflame-containment-and-.blocked_reason: The rules for storing and restricting access to multiple power-bearing reserves are beyond the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.blackflame-heat-vulnerabili.name: Blackflame heat vulnerability

effect.summary: Ordinary heat and flame reduce or extinguish Blackflame, while cold and ice can restore damage to it.

mystara.rule.blackflame-heat-vulnerabili.cost_or_limit: Large flames have 72 hit points, substantial ones 60, smallish ones 48, and a single tongue 24.
mystara.rule.blackflame-heat-vulnerabili.go_wrong: Heat or fire damage can quench the flame.
mystara.rule.blackflame-heat-vulnerabili.combines: Its combustion needs gases but not breathable air.
mystara.rule.blackflame-heat-vulnerabili.blocked_reason: This is a direct durability and damage interaction rule.

mystara.rule.blackflame-and-immortals.name: Blackflame and Immortals

effect.summary: Blackflame outlines certain Energy Immortals or acceptable artifacts, then becomes ordinary flame and harmlessly vanishes.

mystara.rule.blackflame-and-immortals.cost_or_limit: Only applies in the presence of qualifying Immortals or artifacts.
mystara.rule.blackflame-and-immortals.go_wrong: The Blackflame dissipates after the reaction.
mystara.rule.blackflame-and-immortals.who_may: Blackflame reacts; hin need only witness or know this mystery.
mystara.rule.blackflame-and-immortals.combines: Can identify Immortal identities and artifacts acceptable to an Energy Immortal.
mystara.rule.blackflame-and-immortals.blocked_reason: A triggered visual change followed by harmless disappearance fits the basic grammar.

mystara.rule.magic-crafting-time-and-xp-.name: Magic-crafting time and XP cost

effect.summary: Enchanting takes a base day plus days for bonuses and properties, with extra time for stronger spell-like properties.

mystara.rule.magic-crafting-time-and-xp-.cost_or_limit: Crafter loses 3,000 XP each day plus a random 1,000–6,000 XP; losses cannot be shared.
mystara.rule.magic-crafting-time-and-xp-.go_wrong: XP and associated levels or hit points are permanently lost, though later adventuring can replace them.
mystara.rule.magic-crafting-time-and-xp-.who_may: A single hin serves as the link.
mystara.rule.magic-crafting-time-and-xp-.combines: The item must be made by the hin or used long enough to become familiar.
mystara.rule.magic-crafting-time-and-xp-.blocked_reason: Costs and time requirements are directly representable as game rules.

mystara.rule.incomplete-enchantment.name: Incomplete enchantment

effect.summary: Crafting may pause between days, but an unfinished item’s powers cannot be used.

mystara.rule.incomplete-enchantment.cost_or_limit: A second crafter must examine an incomplete item before finishing it; examination takes days based on prior work.
mystara.rule.incomplete-enchantment.go_wrong: Using Blackflame for another purpose during an enchantment day wastes that day’s progress while costs remain.
mystara.rule.incomplete-enchantment.combines: A partly enchanted item still detects as magical; instruction or notes can reduce examination time.
mystara.rule.incomplete-enchantment.blocked_reason: The rules distinguish incomplete, detectable, unusable item states and require investigation to resume.

mystara.rule.blacksling-arsenal-access-a.name: Blacksling arsenal access and capacity

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.blacksling-arsenal-access-a.cost_or_limit: The sling stores up to 1d10 + 10 fist-sized objects; additions require Blackflame, and one random object can be retrieved per round by command.
mystara.rule.blacksling-arsenal-access-a.go_wrong: Destroying the sling loses the contents onto another random plane.
mystara.rule.blacksling-arsenal-access-a.who_may: Only the wielder can retrieve objects; others cannot reach, detect, or harm them.
mystara.rule.blacksling-arsenal-access-a.where_from: The arsenal is attached to the sling and accessible within Blackflame's active radius for adding items.
mystara.rule.blacksling-arsenal-access-a.combines: Blackflame enables adding objects to the arsenal.
mystara.rule.blacksling-arsenal-access-a.blocked_reason: This rule depends on inaccessible extradimensional storage, capacity, and random selection.

mystara.rule.sword-of-blackflame-reflect.name: Sword of Blackflame reflection

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.sword-of-blackflame-reflect.cost_or_limit: The sword reflects one magical attack per round and can do so only once per hour.
mystara.rule.sword-of-blackflame-reflect.go_wrong: A reflected attack is permanently absorbed if the bearer does not direct its discharge in the following round, except when its source escapes by leaving the plane.
mystara.rule.sword-of-blackflame-reflect.mind: The bearer can choose the discharge destination only in the stated case where the source has left the plane.
mystara.rule.sword-of-blackflame-reflect.who_may: The sword's bearer can discharge stored magic as described.
mystara.rule.sword-of-blackflame-reflect.where_from: The reflection is a property of the sword.
mystara.rule.sword-of-blackflame-reflect.combines: Applies to spells, spell-like natural powers, and magical-item effects, including area attacks.
mystara.rule.sword-of-blackflame-reflect.mechanism: Automatic spell reflection and temporary magical storage
mystara.rule.sword-of-blackflame-reflect.blocked_reason: The rule intercepts, stores, and redirects other powers, including area effects.

mystara.rule.dagger-of-blackflame-absorb.name: Dagger of Blackflame absorbed-fire limit

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.dagger-of-blackflame-absorb.cost_or_limit: Absorbed fire must be released all at once and cannot be retained for later; release is available once per turn.
mystara.rule.dagger-of-blackflame-absorb.mind: A command word is needed to release the fire.
mystara.rule.dagger-of-blackflame-absorb.who_may: The wielder can release the absorbed fire.
mystara.rule.dagger-of-blackflame-absorb.where_from: The dagger absorbs fire when its unsheathed blade contacts flames.
mystara.rule.dagger-of-blackflame-absorb.combines: Released flames can add damage to a physical attack.
mystara.rule.dagger-of-blackflame-absorb.blocked_reason: The restriction and release can be represented as a timed effect with a stated limit.

mystara.rule.twilight-wine-memory-limit.name: twilight wine memory limit

effect.summary: none

mystara.rule.twilight-wine-memory-limit.cost_or_limit: The drug erases no more than six hours of recent events.
mystara.rule.twilight-wine-memory-limit.go_wrong: A small amount has no effect if spat out promptly after tasting.
mystara.rule.twilight-wine-memory-limit.who_may: Humans and hin are specified as affected.
mystara.rule.twilight-wine-memory-limit.where_from: The drug is called twilight wine.
mystara.rule.twilight-wine-memory-limit.combines: It is added to wine or beer.
mystara.rule.twilight-wine-memory-limit.blocked_reason: The stated memory effect and time limit fit the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.no-laws-against-piracy.name: No laws against piracy

effect.summary: The Shires have no laws against piracy.

mystara.rule.no-laws-against-piracy.combines: The authorities nevertheless conceal the role of hin pirates

mystara.rule.fourthday-rest.name: Fourthday rest

effect.summary: By the Sheriff’s order, miners in Longflask must rest aboveground every fourth day.

mystara.rule.fourthday-rest.cost_or_limit: One rest day every fourth day
mystara.rule.fourthday-rest.combines: Most miners sleep through the rest day

mystara.rule.wardlystone-magical-residue.name: Wardlystone magical residue defeats detection

effect.summary: The region’s faint magical residue makes detection spells useless.

mystara.rule.wardlystone-magical-residue.where_from: Spells cast there by the witch and later searchers
mystara.rule.wardlystone-magical-residue.blocked_reason: The rule hinges on suppressing or confusing divination, a capability outside the basic grammar.

mystara.rule.thantabbar-pool-fouling-fin.name: Thantabbar pool-fouling fine

effect.summary: Fouling park pools by swimming, washing, urinating, or littering incurs a stiff fine.

mystara.rule.thantabbar-pool-fouling-fin.cost_or_limit: Applies to the town’s park pools
mystara.rule.thantabbar-pool-fouling-fin.combines: Pools also serve as emergency water supplies
mystara.rule.thantabbar-pool-fouling-fin.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward legal restriction.

mystara.rule.no-magic-at-the-useless-uni.name: no magic at The Useless Unicorn

effect.summary: Magic use is prohibited in, at, or against the tavern and its occupants.

mystara.rule.no-magic-at-the-useless-uni.cost_or_limit: Applies around the tavern and those inside
mystara.rule.no-magic-at-the-useless-uni.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward restriction on behavior.

mystara.rule.rattlecart-curfew.name: Rattlecart curfew

effect.summary: Curfew applies to guests at the inns, but not to road trade or the tavern.

mystara.rule.rattlecart-curfew.cost_or_limit: Rowdy guests may be reprimanded and refused future stays
mystara.rule.rattlecart-curfew.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward local restriction.

mystara.rule.clay-pipe-first-smoking-pro.name: Clay pipe first-smoking property

effect.summary: Pipes remain somewhat flexible until first smoked, after which that property ends.

mystara.rule.clay-pipe-first-smoking-pro.cost_or_limit: The flexible state lasts only until the first use by smoking
mystara.rule.clay-pipe-first-smoking-pro.who_may: Applies to pipes made by Abran Oldhill and Tethega
mystara.rule.clay-pipe-first-smoking-pro.where_from: Clay taken from Flur banks in Rattlecart
mystara.rule.clay-pipe-first-smoking-pro.combines: Reduces breakage during transport before first use
mystara.rule.clay-pipe-first-smoking-pro.blocked_reason: A one-time lasting material change is representable with the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.toxin-gas-spread-and-dissip.name: toxin gas spread and dissipation

effect.summary: The toxin reacts with air, expands over three rounds, then becomes harmless on the fourth.

mystara.rule.toxin-gas-spread-and-dissip.cost_or_limit: Its radius reaches 20, 30, then 50 feet on successive rounds.
mystara.rule.toxin-gas-spread-and-dissip.combines: Triggered when a buried flask breaks.
mystara.rule.toxin-gas-spread-and-dissip.blocked_reason: The rule requires an expanding area effect with timed expiration.

mystara.rule.wavestone-ship-protection.name: Wavestone ship protection

effect.summary: A ship bearing the Wavestone cannot sink or be harmed by waves, subject to exceptions.

mystara.rule.wavestone-ship-protection.cost_or_limit: Movement and steering damage still apply; a ship burned to the waterline sinks, and removing the stone from a stricken vessel ends protection.
mystara.rule.wavestone-ship-protection.go_wrong: The ship can sink if burned to the waterline or deprived of the stone while stricken.
mystara.rule.wavestone-ship-protection.combines: Requires the Wavestone to be aboard the ship.
mystara.rule.wavestone-ship-protection.blocked_reason: The protection depends on carrying a particular power-bearing item and has explicit exceptions.

mystara.rule.wavestone-invisibility-dura.name: Wavestone invisibility duration and scope

effect.summary: The stone can conceal a ship and all aboard, but only for a limited time or until impact.

mystara.rule.wavestone-invisibility-dura.cost_or_limit: Lasts four turns or until the vessel strikes solid material; those who leave the ship are no longer invisible.
mystara.rule.wavestone-invisibility-dura.go_wrong: Impact ends the effect, and leaving the ship removes the person from its protection.
mystara.rule.wavestone-invisibility-dura.who_may: Any living creature touching the stone can invoke the effect.
mystara.rule.wavestone-invisibility-dura.combines: Covers the ship, its people, and its cargo.
mystara.rule.wavestone-invisibility-dura.blocked_reason: A carried artifact grants a timed concealment effect to multiple targets.

mystara.rule.mujina-impersonation-prepar.name: mujina impersonation preparation

effect.summary: Effective impersonation requires capturing a Krondar alive and learning their habits.

mystara.rule.mujina-impersonation-prepar.cost_or_limit: Captives must be questioned about their life, acquaintances, and mannerisms.
mystara.rule.mujina-impersonation-prepar.combines: Magic and assumed shapes support the deception.
mystara.rule.mujina-impersonation-prepar.blocked_reason: The process depends on taking another person’s form and reproducing their identity.

mystara.rule.portable-vortex-closure.name: portable vortex closure

effect.summary: The vortex closes only when the first chest’s lid reaches the matching chest at the far end.

mystara.rule.portable-vortex-closure.cost_or_limit: The lid races away down the wormhole; horde creatures resist its return, and placing it too soon can strand explorers.
mystara.rule.portable-vortex-closure.go_wrong: The chests vanish to separate planes when the wormhole closes and the Prime Plane is reached again.
mystara.rule.portable-vortex-closure.who_may: Explorers may attempt to carry the lid through the wormhole.
mystara.rule.portable-vortex-closure.combines: Two matching chests and their lids govern closure.
mystara.rule.portable-vortex-closure.blocked_reason: The rule requires traversing a wormhole and using a remote matching chest to close it.

mystara.rule.deep-glaurant-darkness.name: deep glaurant darkness

effect.summary: A glaurant may create magical darkness around itself once every third round.

mystara.rule.deep-glaurant-darkness.cost_or_limit: The darkness lasts one round and can be used every third round.
mystara.rule.deep-glaurant-darkness.where_from: Innate magical capability described for the species.
mystara.rule.deep-glaurant-darkness.blocked_reason: The rule creates a temporary area of magical darkness around its user.

mystara.rule.wychlamp-magic-disruption.name: Wychlamp magic disruption

effect.summary: Magic used within 20 feet of a wychlamp may be redirected, altered, weakened, or nullified.

mystara.rule.wychlamp-magic-disruption.cost_or_limit: Aimed magic is usually deflected randomly; area effects and other nearby magic use the stated random outcomes.
mystara.rule.wychlamp-magic-disruption.go_wrong: A magical effect may rebound on its caster or wielder, change target or area, lose duration or damage, or fail entirely.
mystara.rule.wychlamp-magic-disruption.who_may: Applies to magic near a wychlamp.
mystara.rule.wychlamp-magic-disruption.combines: Magic that reaches a wychlamp is reflected back; the creature itself is never affected by magic.
mystara.rule.wychlamp-magic-disruption.blocked_reason: Randomly altering, redirecting, and reflecting other powers requires power-interaction mechanics.

mystara.rule.wychlamp-lightning-recovery.name: Wychlamp lightning recovery

effect.summary: Lightning damage instead restores a wychlamp's lost hit points, up to full health.

mystara.rule.wychlamp-lightning-recovery.cost_or_limit: Each hit point of lightning damage restores one hit point, capped at full health.
mystara.rule.wychlamp-lightning-recovery.combines: Other fire, heat, cold, and lightning attacks cause no damage; lightning uniquely heals.
mystara.rule.wychlamp-lightning-recovery.blocked_reason: This can be represented as a conditional vitality gain.

mystara.rule.spell-casting.name: Spell Casting

effect.summary: none stated

mystara.rule.spell-casting.cost_or_limit: Only merchant-princes may cast freely; other casters need a merchant-prince or Tutorial Guild member present.
mystara.rule.spell-casting.go_wrong: Unauthorized casting can bring penalties ranging from a fine to death, depending on harm.
mystara.rule.spell-casting.who_may: Merchant-princes cast freely; other casters require supervision.
mystara.rule.spell-casting.combines: Tutorial Guild oversight and criminal penalties.

mystara.rule.black-seal-warrant.name: Black Seal Warrant

effect.summary: An agent who abuses guild authority to obtain magic for personal use may receive a death sentence under the warrant.

mystara.rule.black-seal-warrant.cost_or_limit: Applies to the stated misuse of an agent role.
mystara.rule.black-seal-warrant.combines: Also described as a death warrant for foreigners involved in treasonous intrigue.
mystara.rule.black-seal-warrant.blocked_reason: The passage describes a legal sentence, not a magical effect.

mystara.rule.foreign-currency-conversion.name: foreign currency conversion charge

effect.summary: Foreign currency, gems, or jewels incur a standard five percent charge; local currency has no fee.

mystara.rule.foreign-currency-conversion.cost_or_limit: Five percent conversion charge on foreign specie.
mystara.rule.foreign-currency-conversion.who_may: Applies to visitors using foreign currency or valuables.
mystara.rule.foreign-currency-conversion.combines: Money changers are regulated by the government.

mystara.rule.currency-export-limit.name: currency export limit

effect.summary: Visitors may not take out local currency exceeding 200 gold pieces in value.

mystara.rule.currency-export-limit.combines: Local currency uses a standard system of equivalents.

mystara.rule.midwinter-festival-gambling.name: Midwinter Festival gambling

effect.summary: Wagers of up to 100 gp on sporting events are permitted during the festival.

mystara.rule.midwinter-festival-gambling.cost_or_limit: Limited to the festival, sports wagers, and 100 gp per person.
mystara.rule.midwinter-festival-gambling.go_wrong: Other gambling can bring large fines.
mystara.rule.midwinter-festival-gambling.who_may: People in Minrothad during the festival.
mystara.rule.midwinter-festival-gambling.combines: The public monthly lottery is the other authorized wagering.

mystara.rule.foreign-trade-restriction.name: Foreign trade restriction

effect.summary: Foreigners cannot trade or sell professionally in the islands except directly with the guild controlling that good.

mystara.rule.foreign-trade-restriction.cost_or_limit: Foreign goods must be sold to the relevant guild; if it declines, the foreign seller has no remedy.
mystara.rule.foreign-trade-restriction.go_wrong: Unauthorized foreign business can lead to prosecution.
mystara.rule.foreign-trade-restriction.who_may: Foreigners are restricted; guilds control domestic trade.
mystara.rule.foreign-trade-restriction.combines: Guild monopolies govern specific goods and services.

mystara.rule.magic-item-sales-and-prices.name: magic item sales and prices

effect.summary: Magical items may be sold only to Minrothaddans or foreigners employed by the government, and not below normal retail price.

mystara.rule.magic-item-sales-and-prices.cost_or_limit: Sales must meet the buyer and minimum-price restrictions.
mystara.rule.magic-item-sales-and-prices.go_wrong: Violation may be prosecuted under commercial law.
mystara.rule.magic-item-sales-and-prices.who_may: Authorized sellers under Tutorial Guild supervision.
mystara.rule.magic-item-sales-and-prices.combines: Magical transactions are recorded for tax purposes.

mystara.rule.foreign-transaction-taxes.name: foreign transaction taxes

effect.summary: Foreigners pay an 18 percent tax on proceeds from items or services; supervised magical transactions incur a 20 percent tax including a two percent service fee.

mystara.rule.foreign-transaction-taxes.cost_or_limit: Rates are 18 percent generally and 20 percent for magical sales or services.
mystara.rule.foreign-transaction-taxes.go_wrong: Failure to report or pay can be punished under law.
mystara.rule.foreign-transaction-taxes.combines: Tutorial Guild supervision applies to magic transactions.

mystara.rule.verdier-calendar.name: Verdier calendar

effect.summary: Local timekeeping uses a 336-day year of eleven 30-day months and a midwinter week; weeks have six days.

mystara.rule.verdier-calendar.cost_or_limit: Local accounting uses this calendar, while external trade uses the standard calendar
mystara.rule.verdier-calendar.combines: Its lunar phases shift two days later each year; holidays remain fixed

mystara.rule.beginning-minrothad-charact.name: Beginning Minrothad character skills

effect.summary: Characters gain specified starting skills and can gain more through experience; skill checks roll against an associated ability score, with 20 always failing.

mystara.rule.beginning-minrothad-charact.cost_or_limit: Starting choices vary with Intelligence; skill choices can be traded for permanent improvement
mystara.rule.beginning-minrothad-charact.combines: Skill gains vary by race and experience

mystara.rule.guild-monopoly-on-magic.name: Guild monopoly on magic

effect.summary: Only the Tutorial Guild may legally practise magic in Minrothad.

mystara.rule.guild-monopoly-on-magic.who_may: Tutorial Guild members under its rules.
mystara.rule.guild-monopoly-on-magic.combines: Enforced through inspection and required guild attendance during spellcasting.
mystara.rule.guild-monopoly-on-magic.blocked_reason: The restriction can be represented as a rule barring unauthorized magical workings.

mystara.rule.guild-member-present-for-sp.name: Guild member present for spellcasting

effect.summary: A Tutorial Guild member must attend whenever a spell is cast.

mystara.rule.guild-member-present-for-sp.cost_or_limit: Applies to every spell cast in Minrothad.
mystara.rule.guild-member-present-for-sp.who_may: A Tutorial Guild member must be present.
mystara.rule.guild-member-present-for-sp.blocked_reason: The rule can be enforced as a condition on spell use.

mystara.rule.inspection-of-magical-items.name: Inspection of magical items and magic-users

effect.summary: The Tutorial Guild inspects known magical items and magic-users entering Minrothad.

mystara.rule.inspection-of-magical-items.cost_or_limit: Applies to known items and magic-users entering the country.
mystara.rule.inspection-of-magical-items.combines: Supports the guild's legal control of magic.
mystara.rule.inspection-of-magical-items.blocked_reason: The passage specifies inspection, not a supernatural detection effect.

mystara.rule.tutorial-guild-first-offer-.name: Tutorial Guild first-offer right

effect.summary: The Tutorial Guild may make the first offer on a magic dealer's item, even if it is not intended for sale to the guild.

mystara.rule.tutorial-guild-first-offer-.cost_or_limit: A disputed forced-sale price is set by the parent guilds.
mystara.rule.tutorial-guild-first-offer-.who_may: The Tutorial Guild has the first-offer right.
mystara.rule.tutorial-guild-first-offer-.combines: Applies to items held by magic dealers, including exceptional items.
mystara.rule.tutorial-guild-first-offer-.blocked_reason: This is a commercial rule rather than a supernatural effect.

mystara.rule.guild-identification-requir.name: Guild identification required by law

effect.summary: People must identify their guild by law; caste identification is customary.

mystara.rule.guild-identification-requir.cost_or_limit: Guild identification is legally required; caste identification is customary.
mystara.rule.guild-identification-requir.who_may: Guild members and residents subject to the custom.
mystara.rule.guild-identification-requir.combines: Identification can be shown by tattoo or, for secretive guilds, a token.
mystara.rule.guild-identification-requir.blocked_reason: This rule concerns social status and identification rather than an effect.

mystara.rule.membership-tattoos.name: Membership tattoos

effect.summary: Guild tattoos visibly mark membership and may be embellished to show rank and specialty.

mystara.rule.membership-tattoos.cost_or_limit: Usually applied after apprenticeship; removal uses painful, scarring acid and is limited to leaving or expulsion.
mystara.rule.membership-tattoos.who_may: Most guild members; some secretive guilds use tokens instead.
mystara.rule.membership-tattoos.combines: The tattoo pattern copies the guild's official device.
mystara.rule.membership-tattoos.blocked_reason: Applying and removing a lasting tattoo changes a body's form beyond the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.guild-membership-tokens.name: Guild membership tokens

effect.summary: Some secretive guilds use a removable token as proof of membership after two years of reliable service.

mystara.rule.guild-membership-tokens.cost_or_limit: The token is awarded after two years of service.
mystara.rule.guild-membership-tokens.who_may: Members of guilds that avoid visible identification.
mystara.rule.guild-membership-tokens.combines: The token bears the guild device; members may also wear a misleading tattoo.
mystara.rule.guild-membership-tokens.blocked_reason: This is an identification custom, not a supernatural effect.

mystara.rule.guild-member-purchase-price.name: Guild-member purchase prices

effect.summary: A member pays 40 percent of wholesale for goods from their own guild and wholesale price at other guilds.

mystara.rule.guild-member-purchase-price.cost_or_limit: Buying at the discount for an outsider is frowned upon and repeat offenders may lose the privilege.
mystara.rule.guild-member-purchase-price.go_wrong: Privilege may be revoked for repeated abuse.
mystara.rule.guild-member-purchase-price.blocked_reason: This is a commercial rule rather than a supernatural effect.

mystara.rule.guild-credit.name: Guild credit

effect.summary: Members may buy on account from their own guild without interest; other guilds may extend credit with small interest.

mystara.rule.guild-credit.cost_or_limit: Usually limited to guild business; retail customers pay cash.
mystara.rule.guild-credit.who_may: Guild members, subject to a guild's discretion.
mystara.rule.guild-credit.combines: Other guilds may extend credit case by case.
mystara.rule.guild-credit.blocked_reason: This is an economic rule, not a supernatural effect.

mystara.rule.preferred-customer-status.name: Preferred customer status

effect.summary: Guild members get first choice of goods and services before public sale, except for special orders.

mystara.rule.preferred-customer-status.combines: A remaining passenger berth may be assigned to a member before another passenger.
mystara.rule.preferred-customer-status.blocked_reason: This is a commercial priority rule.

mystara.rule.guild-exchange-rates.name: Guild exchange rates

effect.summary: Guild members receive discounted conversion fees and better exchange rates for personal coin exchange.

mystara.rule.guild-exchange-rates.cost_or_limit: Applies to guild members' personal conversions.

mystara.rule.cut-rate-travel.name: Cut-rate travel

effect.summary: A guild member may trade specialty labor for cheaper or free sea travel.

mystara.rule.cut-rate-travel.cost_or_limit: Requires work in the member's guild specialty before or during the voyage.
mystara.rule.cut-rate-travel.blocked_reason: This is a travel and payment rule.

mystara.rule.free-or-reduced-rate-guild-.name: Free or reduced-rate guild training

effect.summary: Guilds train members free, and cross-training may be available through the Tutorial Guild; outsiders receive no guild instruction.

mystara.rule.free-or-reduced-rate-guild-.cost_or_limit: Instruction is restricted to members and approved cross-training.
mystara.rule.free-or-reduced-rate-guild-.blocked_reason: This is a social access rule, not a supernatural effect.

mystara.rule.magic-practice-authorizatio.name: Magic practice authorization

effect.summary: Only Tutorial Guild spellcasters may practice magic freely in the Isles; visiting mages need supervision.

mystara.rule.magic-practice-authorizatio.cost_or_limit: Defying the restriction is usually illegal.
mystara.rule.magic-practice-authorizatio.go_wrong: The character may face legal consequences.
mystara.rule.magic-practice-authorizatio.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward legal rule.

mystara.rule.isolation-act.name: Isolation Act

effect.summary: The act barred immigration and sharply limited visitors to Minrothad.

mystara.rule.isolation-act.go_wrong: The restriction discouraged innovation and harmed Minrothad's reputation.
mystara.rule.isolation-act.where_from: Passed by Kitrina Meditor in 890 AC; later rescinded.
mystara.rule.isolation-act.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward legal restriction.

mystara.rule.privateer-captive-treatment.name: Privateer captive treatment

effect.summary: Privateers may not kill captives after taking a vessel and must release them near inhabited land.

mystara.rule.privateer-captive-treatment.cost_or_limit: Captives must be landed or set free in boats within sight of inhabited land.
mystara.rule.privateer-captive-treatment.go_wrong: Violation breaches the privateers’ terms with the ruling guild master.
mystara.rule.privateer-captive-treatment.where_from: Minrothad Guilds’ conditions for the Privateers Guild.
mystara.rule.privateer-captive-treatment.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward behavioral rule.

mystara.rule.privateer-service-is-lifelo.name: Privateer service is lifelong

effect.summary: Privateers are told that joining is for life and means living away from most of Minrothad.

mystara.rule.privateer-service-is-lifelo.cost_or_limit: Membership is presented as permanent and remote from home.
mystara.rule.privateer-service-is-lifelo.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward social rule.

mystara.rule.crew-shares-and-owner-s-cut.name: Crew shares and owner’s cut

effect.summary: Ship owners take their share before crew shares are calculated.

mystara.rule.crew-shares-and-owner-s-cut.cost_or_limit: The owner takes a cut off the top; guilds also receive stated percentages of some fees and profits.

mystara.rule.guild-rank-advancement.name: Guild rank advancement

effect.summary: Craft skill and demonstrated mastery determine apprentice, journeyman, and master standing.

mystara.rule.guild-rank-advancement.cost_or_limit: Apprenticeship lasts two to seven years; mastery may take a year or a lifetime.
mystara.rule.guild-rank-advancement.go_wrong: Promotion is not guaranteed, even for qualified craftsmen.
mystara.rule.guild-rank-advancement.combines: Skill score is used as an approximate rank guide.

mystara.rule.five-year-skill-gain-check.name: Five-year skill gain check

effect.summary: An NPC may gain a skill choice after a successful Intelligence check every five game years.

mystara.rule.five-year-skill-gain-check.cost_or_limit: The check must equal or be below Intelligence.
mystara.rule.five-year-skill-gain-check.combines: The new choice can improve existing skills.

mystara.rule.ship-upkeep.name: Ship upkeep

effect.summary: A ship loses speed when it sails without required upkeep.

mystara.rule.ship-upkeep.cost_or_limit: Routine upkeep costs 1 gp per 1,000 miles per hull point; speed falls 10 percent per 1,000 miles without it.
mystara.rule.ship-upkeep.combines: Major overhaul is required after 10,000 miles or one year at sea, whichever comes first.

mystara.rule.ship-overhaul-interval.name: Ship overhaul interval

effect.summary: A vessel needs major maintenance after a year at sea or 10,000 miles of travel.

mystara.rule.ship-overhaul-interval.cost_or_limit: Work is done in port; time depends on expenses, at one day per 100 gp.
mystara.rule.ship-overhaul-interval.go_wrong: Skipping care risks damage and reduced seaworthiness.
mystara.rule.ship-overhaul-interval.combines: Drydocks can reduce careening time by 20–80 percent.

mystara.rule.rations-and-scurvy.name: Rations and scurvy

effect.summary: A prolonged iron-ration diet makes crew susceptible to deficiency disease, which reduces Strength and Constitution.

mystara.rule.rations-and-scurvy.cost_or_limit: After a month without fresh food, 10 percent of crew are affected for each further week; fresh food restores three points weekly.
mystara.rule.rations-and-scurvy.go_wrong: A sailor dies if either attribute reaches zero.
mystara.rule.rations-and-scurvy.combines: Edible cargo can be consumed to address scurvy, lowering its value.

mystara.rule.customs-clearance-before-un.name: Customs clearance before unloading

effect.summary: Cargo cannot be unloaded or sold legally before customs inspection and clearance.

mystara.rule.customs-clearance-before-un.cost_or_limit: Foreign goods generally require a tax stamp and may incur a 1–100 percent or higher tax.
mystara.rule.customs-clearance-before-un.go_wrong: Uncleared goods cannot be legally sold or traded in port.
mystara.rule.customs-clearance-before-un.combines: Harbor authorities may also quarantine or turn away ships.

mystara.rule.cargo-handling-rate.name: Cargo-handling rate

effect.summary: Dock and boat crews move cargo at fixed rates, with slower loading and difficult conditions.

mystara.rule.cargo-handling-rate.cost_or_limit: A dock worker handles 2,000 merchandise per hour; loading takes 50 percent longer than unloading.
mystara.rule.cargo-handling-rate.go_wrong: Bad weather or nighttime work can double or triple handling time.
mystara.rule.cargo-handling-rate.combines: Offshore boat transfer takes longer, especially through surf.

mystara.rule.bargaining-price-adjustment.name: Bargaining price adjustment

effect.summary: The superior bargainer adjusts a cargo price by five percent per skill-level difference.

mystara.rule.bargaining-price-adjustment.cost_or_limit: Appraisal determines the base value when available.
mystara.rule.bargaining-price-adjustment.go_wrong: A failed Wisdom check may cause the weaker bargainer to accept an excessive price.
mystara.rule.bargaining-price-adjustment.mind: A failed check can leave the weaker bargainer persuaded by the pitch.

mystara.rule.broker-point-limit.name: Broker point limit

effect.summary: Broker points modify speculative-trade rolls.

mystara.rule.broker-point-limit.cost_or_limit: Each point gives +1; points are cumulative, not spent, and no character may have more than five.
mystara.rule.broker-point-limit.who_may: Characters and NPCs awarded points by the DM
mystara.rule.broker-point-limit.combines: Can modify trade availability and price rolls.

mystara.rule.sailing-directly-into-the-w.name: Sailing directly into the wind

effect.summary: A sailing ship without magical aid cannot move directly into the wind.

mystara.rule.sailing-directly-into-the-w.cost_or_limit: Unaided sailing cannot make direct progress into the wind.
mystara.rule.sailing-directly-into-the-w.who_may: Applies to sailing ships without magical assistance.
mystara.rule.sailing-directly-into-the-w.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct restriction on ship movement.

mystara.rule.magical-ship-movement.name: Magical ship movement

effect.summary: Some magic changes a vessel’s movement rate by about 10–60 percent.

mystara.rule.magical-ship-movement.cost_or_limit: Most spell effects last briefly; the pouch of winds lasts the voyage.
mystara.rule.magical-ship-movement.go_wrong: Magic can hinder as well as improve movement.
mystara.rule.magical-ship-movement.who_may: Ships affected by spells or magical items.
mystara.rule.magical-ship-movement.combines: Movement changes revise estimated travel time.
mystara.rule.magical-ship-movement.blocked_reason: A sustained movement-rate modifier fits the basic effect grammar.

mystara.rule.passenger-capacity.name: Passenger capacity

effect.summary: A vessel can generally carry passengers equal to 20 percent of its crew complement, rounding down.

mystara.rule.passenger-capacity.cost_or_limit: Passenger space is constrained by the crew-based capacity; additional food is required.
mystara.rule.passenger-capacity.go_wrong: Space limitations may require passengers to sleep in the cargo hold.
mystara.rule.passenger-capacity.combines: Marine personnel count toward the complement.
mystara.rule.passenger-capacity.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward numerical limit on a ship’s carrying capacity.

mystara.rule.navigation-checks.name: Navigation checks

effect.summary: Secret checks can reveal or correct a ship’s course; failure may leave a false position.

mystara.rule.navigation-checks.cost_or_limit: Charts, senses, weather, and suspicion affect checks; winds and poor visibility can drift ships off course.
mystara.rule.navigation-checks.go_wrong: Failed checks can produce incorrect position estimates or actual drift.
mystara.rule.navigation-checks.blocked_reason: The rule resolves through ordinary checks and ship movement.

mystara.rule.sea-encounters.name: Sea encounters

effect.summary: A weekly chance of non-weather encounters uses separate coastal and high-seas tables.

mystara.rule.sea-encounters.cost_or_limit: Ten percent chance per week; encounter probabilities differ by waters.
mystara.rule.sea-encounters.blocked_reason: The rule resolves through a probability roll and encounter table.

mystara.rule.reef-hazards.name: Reef hazards

effect.summary: Reefs may be avoided with a successful sailing check; striking one damages the hull.

mystara.rule.reef-hazards.cost_or_limit: Damage amount is damaged or illegible in the passage.
mystara.rule.reef-hazards.go_wrong: A ship that hits a reef takes hull damage.
mystara.rule.reef-hazards.blocked_reason: The rule uses a skill check and damage.

mystara.rule.pearl-maturation.name: Pearl maturation

effect.summary: Anointed pearl fragments can curl into pearls and, with regular bathing and rituals over centuries, mature into sentient relics with the original’s abilities.

mystara.rule.pearl-maturation.cost_or_limit: Requires sea-dew anointing, monthly seawater bathing, rituals, and centuries of growth.
mystara.rule.pearl-maturation.go_wrong: The resulting pearl does not gain relic abilities until maturity and awakening.
mystara.rule.pearl-maturation.who_may: Those performing the prescribed bathing and rituals
mystara.rule.pearl-maturation.where_from: Pearl fragments anointed with sea dew from the relic.
mystara.rule.pearl-maturation.combines: Uses a vial of sea dew and seawater.
mystara.rule.pearl-maturation.blocked_reason: The rule describes an item changing state and eventually becoming sentient.

mystara.rule.sailing-near-redtongue.name: Sailing near Redtongue

effect.summary: none stated

mystara.rule.sailing-near-redtongue.cost_or_limit: Non-Minrothad sailors passing the southern hex must check sailing skill; Minrothad sailors face a 10% chance of needing the check
mystara.rule.sailing-near-redtongue.go_wrong: Failure encounters a navigation hazard such as submerged lava rock
mystara.rule.sailing-near-redtongue.combines: Hazard is handled like a reef or islet
mystara.rule.sailing-near-redtongue.blocked_reason: This is a conventional check-and-hazard procedure.

mystara.rule.carven-oak-wish-consequence.name: Carven Oak wish consequences

effect.summary: none stated

mystara.rule.carven-oak-wish-consequence.cost_or_limit: Invoking the Oak's power may kill the user.
mystara.rule.carven-oak-wish-consequence.go_wrong: Imprecise wording can produce a disastrous transformation instead of the intended wish.
mystara.rule.carven-oak-wish-consequence.who_may: Anyone able to invoke the Oak's power, as described.
mystara.rule.carven-oak-wish-consequence.combines: The example wish to become young turns Ulard into a baby elf.

mystara.rule.carven-oak-destruction-rele.name: Carven Oak destruction releases Oleyan

effect.summary: none stated

mystara.rule.carven-oak-destruction-rele.cost_or_limit: The artifact must be destroyed to free the Immortal trapped within.
mystara.rule.carven-oak-destruction-rele.go_wrong: The Immortal who imprisoned Oleyan may retaliate.
mystara.rule.carven-oak-destruction-rele.who_may: Anyone who can discover and carry out the method of destruction.
mystara.rule.carven-oak-destruction-rele.combines: A suggested method is immersing the Oak in lava on the Plane of Fire.
mystara.rule.carven-oak-destruction-rele.blocked_reason: The rule depends on a being bound to an artifact and released by its destruction.

effect.summary: Exceeding a tribe’s sustainable population leads to starvation and likely raiding.

mystara.rule.humanoid-language-and-liter.name: Humanoid language and literacy

effect.summary: Humanoids are illiterate and know only their tribal dialect.

mystara.rule.humanoid-language-and-liter.cost_or_limit: Applies to humanoids regardless of their natural Intelligence.
mystara.rule.humanoid-language-and-liter.blocked_reason: This is a usable setting constraint.

mystara.rule.troll-regeneration.name: Troll regeneration

effect.summary: Trolls regenerate, an ability they gain on becoming a Normal Monster.

mystara.rule.troll-regeneration.cost_or_limit: Only gained at Normal Monster status.
mystara.rule.troll-regeneration.blocked_reason: The passage gives no healing rate or operating details for the regeneration effect.

effect.summary: Above level 20, every two D&D levels count as one AD&D level, rounded up.

mystara.rule.dominion-population-growth.name: Dominion population growth

effect.summary: Dominion populations grow by an average of 15% plus 5d10 people monthly, with growth topping out at 145% plus 5d10.

mystara.rule.dominion-population-growth.cost_or_limit: Growth is limited by the stated upper rate.

mystara.rule.command-limitation.name: Command Limitation

effect.summary: A humanoid’s retainer capacity is measured in Hit Dice: 2 at first level, 5 at second, 10 at third, then 10 more per later level.

mystara.rule.command-limitation.cost_or_limit: Kobold Hit Dice count fully; certain goblin and hobgoblin Hit Dice modifiers are ignored.
mystara.rule.command-limitation.combines: Subordinate chiefs’ retainers do not count against the commander’s limit.

mystara.rule.length-of-service.name: Length of Service

effect.summary: Retainers serve until dismissed or taken over by another chief while their chief is absent.

mystara.rule.length-of-service.cost_or_limit: Deserters do not return; failing to punish captured deserters lowers morale and Charisma by one point until dealt with.
mystara.rule.length-of-service.go_wrong: Retainers may desert or be taken over.

mystara.rule.other-chiefs-retainers.name: Other Chiefs’ Retainers

effect.summary: Taking another chief’s retainers is harder when their chief is higher level, and impossible while that chief is present.

mystara.rule.other-chiefs-retainers.cost_or_limit: The Charisma check takes a penalty for each level of difference.
mystara.rule.other-chiefs-retainers.who_may: Humanoid characters attempting to take retainers

mystara.rule.initial-skills.name: Initial Skills

effect.summary: Normal Monster-level humanoids start with four skills, adjusted by Intelligence; younger characters cannot use skills effectively.

mystara.rule.initial-skills.cost_or_limit: Skills must be chosen at character creation.
mystara.rule.initial-skills.combines: Intelligence bonuses can grant extra choices.

mystara.rule.how-skills-are-used.name: How Skills Are Used

effect.summary: A skill check succeeds on a d20 roll at or below its associated ability score; 20 always fails.

mystara.rule.how-skills-are-used.cost_or_limit: Exceptional tasks may require additional success conditions; the DM sets modifiers and results.
mystara.rule.how-skills-are-used.go_wrong: A failed check may alert or thwart others, depending on the task.
mystara.rule.how-skills-are-used.combines: Ability-score changes also affect skill checks.

mystara.rule.improving-skills.name: Improving Skills

effect.summary: A character can trade skill choices for a permanent bonus to another skill.

mystara.rule.improving-skills.cost_or_limit: Each choice traded gives a +1 bonus.
mystara.rule.improving-skills.who_may: Characters with skill choices to trade

mystara.rule.learning-more-skills.name: Learning More Skills

effect.summary: Characters gain a skill choice every four experience levels and must study the new skill in advance.

mystara.rule.learning-more-skills.cost_or_limit: A teacher must exist and agree to teach, or the character must quest for one; delayed learning imposes penalties and may lose the choice.
mystara.rule.learning-more-skills.go_wrong: Failure to find a teacher by the required level loses the skill choice.
mystara.rule.learning-more-skills.where_from: A willing teacher in the tribe or a quest beyond it
mystara.rule.learning-more-skills.combines: Skill choices can be spent to remove penalties or improve a skill.

mystara.rule.all-humanoids-have-the-natu.name: All humanoids have the natural ability to command troops

effect.summary: Humanoids can exert authority over humanoids who understand them, based on reputation and intimidation.

mystara.rule.all-humanoids-have-the-natu.cost_or_limit: The ability works only on eligible humanoid NPCs and normal monsters with fewer Hit Dice, never on PCs.
mystara.rule.all-humanoids-have-the-natu.mind: Subordinates may obey because of intimidation and perceived authority.
mystara.rule.all-humanoids-have-the-natu.combines: Forms a tribal hierarchy and supports retainer recruitment.
mystara.rule.all-humanoids-have-the-natu.blocked_reason: The rule explains a mechanism that changes followers’ decisions and allegiance.

mystara.rule.charisma-check.name: Charisma Check

effect.summary: A command attempt succeeds when a d20 roll is no higher than the character’s Charisma.

mystara.rule.charisma-check.cost_or_limit: One attempt per day; group attempts take a penalty per ten subordinates.
mystara.rule.charisma-check.go_wrong: Failure may make an NPC target a rival who fails later Reaction Checks.
mystara.rule.charisma-check.mind: The target decides whether joining is safer.
mystara.rule.charisma-check.who_may: Humanoid characters using the command ability
mystara.rule.charisma-check.combines: Other penalties and bonuses can modify the check.
mystara.rule.charisma-check.blocked_reason: Success establishes a lasting subordinate relationship, while failure can alter the target’s attitude.

mystara.rule.command-modifiers.name: Command Modifiers

effect.summary: Command checks take penalties for rival tribes or hordes, hostility, pariah status, and some racial pairings; name-level characters gain a bonus.

mystara.rule.command-modifiers.cost_or_limit: The stated modifiers alter the check result.
mystara.rule.command-modifiers.combines: Works with Charisma checks and the Racial Tolerance Table.

mystara.rule.humanoid-tribal-dialects.name: Humanoid tribal dialects

effect.summary: Humanoids speak tribe-specific dialects; same-race tribes may or may not understand one another.

mystara.rule.humanoid-tribal-dialects.cost_or_limit: When a tribe lacks Common Tharian, an even 1d6 result means mutual understanding
mystara.rule.humanoid-tribal-dialects.go_wrong: Odd results mean the groups cannot understand one another
mystara.rule.humanoid-tribal-dialects.combines: Common Tharian is shared by Broken Lands humanoids serving King Thar

mystara.rule.common-tharian-language.name: Common Tharian Language

effect.summary: Since King Thar’s crowning, Broken Lands humanoids serving his chieftains speak a shared military jargon.

mystara.rule.common-tharian-language.cost_or_limit: Does not count as an extra foreign language for character creation
mystara.rule.common-tharian-language.who_may: Humanoids of the Broken Lands serving King Thar’s chieftains

mystara.rule.learning-extra-languages.name: Learning extra languages

effect.summary: Additional languages require spending a skill choice; Intelligence bonuses do not normally grant starting languages.

mystara.rule.learning-extra-languages.cost_or_limit: One extra skill choice per language; DM may authorize exceptions

effect.summary: One to ten clans usually form a horde, and clans take their chieftain’s name.

mystara.rule.tribal-standing.name: Tribal standing

effect.summary: A roll modified by Strength, Constitution, Intelligence, and Wisdom determines a character’s master and standing in the horde.

mystara.rule.tribal-standing.cost_or_limit: Roll 1d20 and add unmodified Strength and Constitution; subtract unmodified Intelligence and Wisdom
mystara.rule.tribal-standing.go_wrong: The result can place the character as a pariah or under a particular rank of master
mystara.rule.tribal-standing.combines: Racial ability modifiers are removed before calculating scores

mystara.rule.humanoid-equipment-access.name: Humanoid equipment access

effect.summary: Hordes have no shops or developed commercial structure; equipment is mainly traded, scavenged, stolen, or won.

mystara.rule.humanoid-equipment-access.cost_or_limit: Starting equipment may be poor or defective; later equipment cannot normally be gained through the same starting-treasure exchange
mystara.rule.humanoid-equipment-access.go_wrong: Weak members may receive damaged leftovers
mystara.rule.humanoid-equipment-access.combines: Chiefs and stronger tribesmen get first choice of war prizes

mystara.rule.weapon-defect-rolls.name: Weapon defect rolls

effect.summary: Scavenged weapons receive cumulative defects determined by rolling on the relevant weapon table.

mystara.rule.weapon-defect-rolls.cost_or_limit: Roll 1d20 for each scavenged weapon; a result of 19–20 may require further rolls
mystara.rule.weapon-defect-rolls.go_wrong: Defects can reduce damage or accuracy, alter the damage die, or break the weapon
mystara.rule.weapon-defect-rolls.combines: Damage cannot fall below one; hit penalties cannot exceed −5

mystara.rule.weapon-break-check.name: Weapon break check

effect.summary: A defective weapon may break after a qualifying hit roll or maximum damage if the wielder succeeds at a Strength check.

mystara.rule.weapon-break-check.cost_or_limit: Triggered by an unmodified roll of 1 to hit or maximum damage
mystara.rule.weapon-break-check.go_wrong: A successful Strength check breaks the weapon; a failed check leaves it intact
mystara.rule.weapon-break-check.blocked_reason: The rule changes an item’s condition and can destroy it.

mystara.rule.oversized-weapon-use.name: Oversized weapon use

effect.summary: Weapon size relative to creature size governs permitted use, attack penalties, cost, encumbrance, and possible damage bonuses.

mystara.rule.oversized-weapon-use.cost_or_limit: Creature size bands and minimum Strength determine use and bonuses
mystara.rule.oversized-weapon-use.go_wrong: Small creatures cannot use certain heavy weapons; size mismatch can penalize attacks

mystara.rule.huge-weapon-scaling.name: Huge weapon scaling

effect.summary: For every additional four feet of creature size, weapon cost, damage, and encumbrance increase by the established size pattern.

mystara.rule.huge-weapon-scaling.cost_or_limit: Strength 18 is required for the extra damage bonus on huge weapons
mystara.rule.huge-weapon-scaling.who_may: Very large creatures, if allowed by the campaign
mystara.rule.huge-weapon-scaling.combines: Uses the large and very large weapon scaling pattern

mystara.rule.partial-armor-cost-and-encu.name: Partial armor cost and encumbrance

effect.summary: Individual armor pieces have fractional costs and encumbrance; mismatched sets may exceed normal totals.

mystara.rule.partial-armor-cost-and-encu.cost_or_limit: Piece values are fractions of the corresponding full armor
mystara.rule.partial-armor-cost-and-encu.go_wrong: Mismatched pieces can cost more and encumber more than a regular set
mystara.rule.partial-armor-cost-and-encu.combines: Piece fractions depend on armor type

mystara.rule.padded-fur-armor.name: Padded fur armor

effect.summary: Provides armor class 8 at a stated price and encumbrance.

mystara.rule.padded-fur-armor.go_wrong: Cannot be worn in hot climates
mystara.rule.padded-fur-armor.who_may: Characters able to wear the armor outside hot climates

mystara.rule.partial-armor-protection-ra.name: Partial armor protection ratings

effect.summary: Armor-piece ratings are summed and converted into an armor-class improvement by dividing by ten and rounding down.

mystara.rule.partial-armor-protection-ra.cost_or_limit: Each ten protection points improve armor class by one; shield retains its normal bonus
mystara.rule.partial-armor-protection-ra.combines: Armor material and covered area determine points

mystara.rule.armor-failure.name: Armor failure

effect.summary: A foe’s unmodified 20 to hit can cause armor to shift, fall off, break, rattle, or be destroyed.

mystara.rule.armor-failure.cost_or_limit: Failure outcome is determined by a d8 roll
mystara.rule.armor-failure.go_wrong: Armor may lose protection, require repairs, or be destroyed; severe outcomes may affect retainers’ morale
mystara.rule.armor-failure.who_may: Wearers of humanoid armor under attack
mystara.rule.armor-failure.combines: A foe must roll an unmodified 20 to hit
mystara.rule.armor-failure.blocked_reason: The rule alters armor condition and may remove or destroy armor pieces.

mystara.rule.armor-size-pricing.name: Armor size pricing

effect.summary: Armor trading value rises by a multiplier for each extra foot or fraction above five feet of wearer height.

mystara.rule.armor-size-pricing.cost_or_limit: Human-size or smaller armor uses conventional price; taller wearers multiply its value by size
mystara.rule.armor-size-pricing.go_wrong: Larger armor becomes more expensive and rare
mystara.rule.armor-size-pricing.combines: Smaller armor pieces may be worn with reduced protection

mystara.rule.wearing-smaller-armor-piece.name: Wearing smaller armor pieces

effect.summary: Armor protection falls by one point per size difference when a smaller piece is worn.

mystara.rule.wearing-smaller-armor-piece.cost_or_limit: A piece cannot be used if its adjusted protection would be below one
mystara.rule.wearing-smaller-armor-piece.go_wrong: Too-small pieces provide no usable protection
mystara.rule.wearing-smaller-armor-piece.who_may: Humanoids wearing armor pieces smaller than their size
mystara.rule.wearing-smaller-armor-piece.combines: Applies to partial armor protection ratings

mystara.rule.armor-protection-reduced-fo.name: Armor protection reduced for oversized wearers

effect.summary: Armor protection can be reduced according to the size mismatch; an optional rule doubles the reduction for a fat wearer.

mystara.rule.armor-protection-reduced-fo.cost_or_limit: A sufficiently mismatched fit can leave armor badly damaged or ruined.
mystara.rule.armor-protection-reduced-fo.go_wrong: A fat character may ruin armor unless an Intelligence Check succeeds.
mystara.rule.armor-protection-reduced-fo.who_may: Characters wearing armor outside its intended size category.
mystara.rule.armor-protection-reduced-fo.combines: Protection ratings and the optional fitness check.
mystara.rule.armor-protection-reduced-fo.blocked_reason: Protection and equipment condition can be tracked as ordinary game values.

mystara.rule.oversized-armor-encumbrance.name: Oversized armor encumbrance

effect.summary: A smaller wearer’s armor encumbrance is multiplied by the size-category difference.

mystara.rule.oversized-armor-encumbrance.cost_or_limit: The DM may apply this only when armor exceeds the wearer’s normal size; encumbrance is relative to the bearer.
mystara.rule.oversized-armor-encumbrance.go_wrong: The wearer may struggle to walk and need Dexterity Checks to avoid tripping.
mystara.rule.oversized-armor-encumbrance.combines: May be adjusted for additional weight at the DM’s option.
mystara.rule.oversized-armor-encumbrance.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct multiplier to an ordinary equipment value.

mystara.rule.ritual-of-passage.name: Ritual of Passage

effect.summary: A spellcasting apprentice must undergo a craft ritual, which can cause permanent sacrifices or grant a benefit.

mystara.rule.ritual-of-passage.cost_or_limit: No spellcasting abilities are gained without completing it; effects are determined by the sacrifice table.
mystara.rule.ritual-of-passage.go_wrong: Possible permanent hit-point or Constitution loss; reaching 0 hit points or Constitution 2 or less means death.
mystara.rule.ritual-of-passage.combines: May increase accumulated experience as specified by the result.
mystara.rule.ritual-of-passage.blocked_reason: The procedure resolves through ordinary traits, hit points, and advancement values.

mystara.rule.extra-experience-table.name: Extra Experience Table

effect.summary: Spellcasting levels require extra experience added to the character’s normal advancement requirements.

mystara.rule.extra-experience-table.cost_or_limit: The required extra experience rises by spellcasting level.
mystara.rule.extra-experience-table.who_may: Wiccas and shamans advancing spellcasting levels.
mystara.rule.extra-experience-table.combines: Dual-craft characters must meet the experience requirements for both crafts.
mystara.rule.extra-experience-table.blocked_reason: The mechanism is an ordinary advancement cost.
